Hyderabad SITE Association of Trade and Industry (HSATI) Chairman Zubair Ahmed Ghanghra has criticised an increase of Rs2,500 in the price of a wheat bag, saying the government has failed to control inflation and protect consumers from rising food costs.
He said the increase in wheat and flour prices had placed an additional burden on low- and middle-income households, which were already struggling to meet their basic needs amid persistent inflation. He urged the government to take immediate measures to stabilise prices and ensure that essential food items remained affordable.
Ghanghra stated the government had previously purchased wheat from farmers under provincial budget allocations, a policy that helped maintain price stability and provide relief to consumers. However, the government's decision to stop wheat procurement contributed to price increases and intensified difficulties for the public.
He also questioned the impact of International Monetary Fund (IMF) conditions on government policies, arguing that the authorities should prioritise food affordability while negotiating with the lender.
The HSATI chairman criticised what he described as inconsistent scrutiny of government spending and public relief measures. He questioned why increases in the salaries and benefits of lawmakers and ministers, along with purchases of new vehicles and government aircraft, did not attract the same level of concern that measures to reduce food prices faced. He said this disparity reflected an unfair burden on ordinary citizens, who continued to absorb higher living costs without corresponding increases in their incomes. Ghanghra urged the government to raise the issue of food affordability during negotiations with the IMF and take effective measures to shield essential commodities from inflationary pressures.
He also called on the authorities to investigate the reasons behind the increase in wheat and flour prices and take strict action against hoarding and profiteering. He said stronger market monitoring and enforcement could help prevent traders from exploiting supply conditions to charge excessive prices.
The HSATI chairman warned that persistent increases in the prices of essential goods, without a corresponding rise in household incomes, continued to erode purchasing power and deepen financial pressures on ordinary families.
He said the government must move beyond assurances and introduce practical measures to keep wheat, flour and other staple food within the reach of consumers. He stressed that people needed tangible relief rather than promises as rising food costs continued to strain household budgets.

items.author: Our Correspondent
items.content:
The Pakistan Microfinance Network (PMN) concluded the 10th Annual Microfinance Conference (AMC-X) in Karachi, bringing together government officials, regulators, financial institutions, development partners and experts to shape the next phase of financial inclusion.
It was organised in collaboration with the United Nations Industrial Development Organisation (Unido) under the EU-funded Poverty Alleviation and Inclusive Development across Rural Sindh (PAIDAR) programme. Under the theme "Pathways for Inclusive Growth: Unlocking Synergies," discussions focused on moving beyond financial access towards client progression, resilience and measurable economic outcomes, particularly for women, farmers, microenterprises and underserved rural communities.
Addressing the conference virtually, Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb placed financial inclusion within Pakistan's wider transition from macroeconomic stabilisation towards sustainable growth. He called for greater use of cash flow-based rather than collateral-based lending, digital credit tools and alternative data to bring more borrowers into formal finance, particularly in agriculture and SMEs.
"It's not just how much you lend, how many borrowers you have, but also start measuring outcomes," he said, highlighting borrower graduation, job creation and women's economic participation as important measures of success.
Opening the conference, Amir Khan, Chairman PMN and President & CEO, HBL Microfinance Bank, called for microfinance to be integrated into the wider financial system. "The principle behind everything to follow is to mainstream microfinance into the financial ecosystem, not as a parallel track," he said. Khan stressed that the sector's next decade should be judged not only by outreach but by whether clients were able to progress towards stronger businesses, assets and financial independence.

items.title: Toyota Is Bringing a Hydrogen Hilux in 2028 With 400+ km Range
items.summary:
Toyota is continuing its push into hydrogen mobility, with a fuel-cell Hilux scheduled to enter production in 2028.
The hydrogen-powered pickup is being developed with a target driving range of more than 400 km under WLTP testing, giving Toyota another alternative powertrain for its commercial vehicle lineup.
Over 400 km Range and 2,500 kg Towing Target
Toyota outlined the latest development targets at IAA Transportation in Hannover on September 14, 2026. Alongside the targeted range, the company is also aiming for a towing capacity of up to 2,500 kg.
Both figures remain development targets and are not yet final certified specifications.
Toyota has previously confirmed that the hydrogen Hilux is planned for Europe and Oceania from 2028. There is currently no confirmed timeline for Pakistan.
How the Fuel-Cell Hilux Works
The Hilux FCEV uses hydrogen to generate electricity onboard.
A fuel cell combines hydrogen with oxygen from the air, producing electricity that powers an electric moto
items.author: Afaq Wajdan Malik
items.content:
Toyota is continuing its push into hydrogen mobility, with a fuel-cell Hilux scheduled to enter production in 2028.
The hydrogen-powered pickup is being developed with a target driving range of more than 400 km under WLTP testing, giving Toyota another alternative powertrain for its commercial vehicle lineup.
Over 400 km Range and 2,500 kg Towing Target
Toyota outlined the latest development targets at IAA Transportation in Hannover on September 14, 2026. Alongside the targeted range, the company is also aiming for a towing capacity of up to 2,500 kg.
Both figures remain development targets and are not yet final certified specifications.
Toyota has previously confirmed that the hydrogen Hilux is planned for Europe and Oceania from 2028. There is currently no confirmed timeline for Pakistan.
How the Fuel-Cell Hilux Works
The Hilux FCEV uses hydrogen to generate electricity onboard.
A fuel cell combines hydrogen with oxygen from the air, producing electricity that powers an electric motor. Water is produced as the main byproduct of the chemical reaction.
This is different from a hydrogen combustion engine, which burns hydrogen directly inside an engine.
Toyota already uses fuel-cell technology in the Mirai and is applying similar principles to larger commercial vehicles.
Toyota Is Testing Hydrogen Beyond the Hilux
Toyota’s hydrogen strategy extends beyond passenger cars and pickups.
The company is working with Scania and IVECO on fuel-cell systems for heavy-duty trucks.
Toyota GAZOO Racing also plans to enter a fuel-cell Hilux in the Dakar Rally Future Mission 1000 category in 2027.
The project is expected to provide another demanding testing environment for the technology before the production Hilux arrives.
Toyota is separately developing hydrogen combustion engines through its motorsport programs.
Infrastructure Remains the Biggest Challenge
Toyota has acknowledged that hydrogen vehicles cannot succeed on their own.
A viable market also requires widespread hydrogen production, distribution and refuelling infrastructure, along with customer demand and supportive regulations.
That remains one of the biggest barriers to wider adoption of fuel-cell vehicles.
For now, the key milestone is the planned 2028 launch of the Hilux FCEV, while its final range, towing capacity and other production specifications will be confirmed closer to launch.

items.title: Xpeng to Launch L03 REEV With 1100 KM Range in Pakistan
items.summary:
The XPeng L03 REEV is set to launch in Pakistan on October 12, adding another range-extended electric vehicle to the country’s growing lineup.
With the launch only two days away, XPeng has already revealed some of the model’s key range and charging figures. Pricing, booking details and the full local specification will be announced at launch.
250 km Electric Range
The XPeng L03 REEV offers a claimed 250 km electric-only range.
Its total combined range rises to around 1,100 km, giving drivers the flexibility of electric driving for shorter trips while retaining the extended range provided by its range-extender system.
These figures are among the main specifications confirmed ahead of the Pakistan launch.
123 kW DC Fast Charging
The L03 REEV supports up to 123 kW DC fast charging.
XPeng claims the battery can charge from 10% to 90% in around 20 minutes under suitable charging conditions.
Actual charging times can vary depending on charger output, battery temperature, and other conditions

items.author: Afaq Wajdan Malik
items.content:
BYD is discussing the introduction of its next-generation ultra-fast EV charging technology in Pakistan with Mega Motor Company, although deployment will depend on local infrastructure and future vehicle plans.
BYD Vice President Liu Xueliang said the company is evaluating the technology for Pakistan as part of its broader expansion in the country.
Charging Could Reach 1,500kW
BYD’s second-generation Blade Battery works with its new FLASH Charging system, which can deliver up to 1,500kW through a single connector.
According to BYD, compatible vehicles can charge from:
10% to 70% in five minutes
10% to 97% in nine minutes
20% to 97% in 12 minutes at -30°C
These figures apply to BYD’s new battery and charging platform and should not be treated as charging times for every BYD vehicle currently available in Pakistan.
Pakistan Needs Supporting Infrastructure
Liu said any local rollout would depend on infrastructure readiness, stakeholder discussions and BYD’s future product plans.
Existing BYD vehicles would remain compatible with future charging infrastructure, although they would not necessarily support the maximum charging speeds.
The fastest rates would require vehicles designed around BYD’s newer battery platform.
A higher-powered charger also does not automatically make every EV charge faster. Actual charging speed depends on the vehicle’s battery capacity, architecture and maximum supported charging rate.
Local BYD Assembly Plant Also Nearing Launch
BYD is also moving closer to starting local vehicle assembly in Pakistan.
Liu said the company’s local assembly facility is targeted to begin operations in the second half of 2026.
The plant is designed to produce around 25,000 vehicles per year, with the ability to expand capacity to 50,000 units annually.
The charging network discussions could support BYD’s wider local expansion as it introduces more electric and electrified vehicles to the Pakistani market.
However, BYD has not yet announced a confirmed launch date for either the ultra-fast charging network or local vehicle production.

items.author: Afaq Wajdan Malik
items.content:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has taken notice of the death of Laiba Ejaz, a 22-year-old student of the International Islamic University Islamabad (IIUI), and ordered immediate action against those allegedly involved in defrauding her.
The prime minister described the incident as deeply regrettable and directed the Inspector General of Islamabad Police and the Chief Commissioner Islamabad to ensure that the accused is taken into custody without delay.
Laiba’s body was recovered from a green belt in Islamabad’s G-10 area, within the jurisdiction of Ramna Police Station. Police said initial circumstances suggested a possible suicide, but investigators have not yet announced a final conclusion regarding her death.
Her family has alleged that an education consultant took millions of rupees after promising to arrange her admission to a US university and later provided documents that turned out to be fake.
Different reports have put the alleged amount at between Rs. 5 million and Rs. 7 million, while the exact figure and the consultant’s role remain under investigation.
Family members said Laiba had completed her studies at IIUI with strong academic results and hoped to pursue higher education abroad. They also alleged that the family had arranged the money through the sale of property and other financial sacrifices.
The Federal Investigation Agency (FIA) has also taken notice of the alleged fraud and contacted Laiba’s family as part of its inquiry.
Prime Minister Shehbaz directed authorities to arrest the accused promptly and ensure that anyone found responsible is punished strictly in accordance with the law.
The alleged fraud, its exact financial details and any connection between it and Laiba’s death are still being investigated.

items.title: Is Islamabad Police Establishing a Punjab-Like CCD Wing?
items.summary:
Islamabad Police has denied reports claiming that a Punjab-style Crime Control Department (CCD) unit is being established in the federal capital.
A police spokesperson termed the reports baseless and unverified, saying no such new CCD-style wing is being set up.
The spokesperson said Islamabad Police already has dedicated departmental units that are performing their assigned duties effectively.
Islamabad Police currently operates specialized units for different types of policing and investigations, including counter-terrorism and crime investigation functions, rather than relying on a single new CCD-style structure.
The clarification comes as the capital police continue to focus on strengthening existing policing arrangements, including surveillance, patrolling and action against criminal elements across different zones.
Police have urged citizens and social media users to avoid sharing unverified reports and rely on official information.

items.author: Akshit Pushkarna
items.content:
Most new-age tech stocks gained this week, as benchmark indices snapped an eight-week losing streak despite a midweek sell-off. Among the 66 stocks tracked until last week, 36 rose 0.1% to nearly 25%, while 30 fell in the range of 0.23% to 13.93%.
MobiKwik led gains, rising nearly 25% to ₹245.40, followed by PhysicsWallah (19.68%), Fino Payments Bank (8.9%), Nykaa (5.97%), and Eternal (3.14%).
E2E Networks, Shadowfax, SEDEMAC, Zelio E-Mobility, Aequs, and Kissht touched fresh highs. IndiaMART, Fractal, Turtlemint, PB Fintech, Klassroom, and Yudiz hit fresh lows.
NSE SME-listed Yudiz led declines, falling 13.93% to ₹20.70, followed by BSE SME-listed Zappfresh, down 9.24% at ₹54.90.
Snapdeal parent AceVector became the 67th stock under Inc42’s coverage after listing on Monday (October 5). It closed the week at ₹30.61, up 8.16% from its ₹28.30 BSE listing price but 4.3% below its ₹32 IPO price.
Including AceVector, the 67 companies’ combined market capitalisation stood at $154.71 Bn, against $153.61 Bn for 66 companies last week.
Key company developments this week included business updates, founder share pledges, and institutional stake sales.
Quarterly Business Updates
Nykaa projected Q2 FY27 net revenue growth in the high-twenties percentage range, while Honasa expects net sales value growth in the low-thirties percentage range. Both stocks gained.
Aye Finance’s Q2 AUM rose 26% YoY to ₹7,604 Cr, and disbursements increased 10% to ₹1,403 Cr. Its shares declined.
Fino reported September loan referral disbursals of ₹278 Cr, up 223% YoY, while renewal income rose 20% to ₹28 Cr and average deposits increased 13% to ₹2,794 Cr.
Founder Share Pledges
ideaForge CEO and promoter Ankit Mehta pledged 2.8 Lakh shares worth ₹20.56 Cr to Infina Finance for personal financial requirements, taking shares pledged to the lender to 6.5 Lakh (1.3%).
Separately, ideaForge signed a ₹151 Cr Technology Development Board loan agreement for its YETI heavy-lift, long-range autonomous aerial logistics vehicle project, with disbursement in tranches.
Ola Electric founder and CMD Bhavish Aggarwal pledged a 4.32% stake to participate in its ₹1,000 Cr rights issue. Open from October 22-30, the issue is priced at ₹27. The stock closed the week at ₹35.13 on the BSE.
Institutional Stake Sales
Peak XV sold 12.2 Lakh Awfis shares for ₹29.8 Cr at ₹245 apiece, cutting its holding by more than half. Awfis has fallen nearly 59% in a year, despite Q1 FY27 profit rising 140% YoY to ₹24 Cr.
TPG sold 40 Lakh Shadowfax shares for ₹114.8 Cr, its fourth sale in three months, taking cumulative sales to over ₹729 Cr. Notably, Shadowfax has rallied over 144% in six months.
Meesho’s Kirana Club Investment
Meesho approved investing up to ₹50 Cr more in Kirana Club parent Retail Pulse Labs, in tranches over a year after the first acquisition tranche closes. Its proposed ₹202 Cr acquisition remains incomplete, with the acquisition consideration unchanged.
Fractal’s Board Change, Qatar Expansion
Fractal appointed TPG MD Vivek Mohan as chairman. Outgoing chairman and Apax Foundation co-CEO Rohan Haldea remains a director.
It also incorporated a wholly owned step-down subsidiary FRACTAL AI QFZ LLC in Qatar Free Zones with QAR 1 Lakh capital for software development, IT consulting, network support, and AI services.
GlobalBees’ Mush Exit
FirstCry subsidiary GlobalBees signed an MoU to sell its entire 51.54% stake in Mush Textile for ₹5.69 Cr, with completion expected by October 15.
The transaction covers Mush and BePlush, which generated ₹16.12 Cr turnover across GlobalBees subsidiaries in FY26. Mush Textile contributed ₹11.34 Cr revenue and ₹2.09 Cr net worth to FirstCry’s consolidated financials.
Existing shareholders Nihar Gosalia and Vaishvik Brahmbhatt will acquire 13.45% and 38.09% stake, respectively.
Aequs’ Aerospace Investment
Aequs invested ₹15.75 Cr in JV Ajna Aerospace & Defence, receiving 45 Lakh partly paid-up rights shares priced at ₹100, with ₹35 paid upfront. Its stake remains unchanged. The UAV and autonomous aerial systems maker will fund capex, operations, and general business requirements.
Now, let’s take a look at the performance of the broader market this week.
Benchmarks End Losing Streak
The Sensex rose 0.78% to 72,472.33 and the Nifty gained 0.44% to 22,520.45, recovering after the latter hit a 52-week low of 22,180.
The RBI raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50% and shifted to “calibrated tightening” during the week. It also raised FY27 growth and inflation forecasts.
InvestorAi cofounder and CEO Bruce Keith said the hike was expected amid geopolitical tensions, rupee weakness, inflation, and Brent above $100. He said the RBI’s stance signals further hikes as El Nion’s impact becomes clearer.
FIIs sold ₹30,294 Cr of equities, their eighth consecutive week of selling, while DIIs bought ₹30,313 Cr, supporting yesterday’s recovery.
Meanwhile, the GST Council on Thursday (October 8) recommended withdrawing arrest powers and raising the prosecution threshold from ₹1 Cr to ₹5 Cr.
Next week, CPI and WPI data for September will be in focus. Religare Broking’s SVP of research, Ajit Mishra, said Nifty has support at 22,200-22,400, with recovery potential towards 23,000-23,300 or downside to 21,700-22,000 on a breakdown.
He flagged crude, geopolitics, and global bond yields as key influences. Rising oil prices could pressure inflation, the rupee, and margins, while progress in Iran-US negotiations could offer relief.
Now, let’s take a look at MobiKwik and RentoMojo weekly performance.
MobiKwik’s Volatile Rally
Shares of MobiKwik hit the 20% upper circuit at ₹242.14 on Tuesday (October 6) amid a technical breakout, heavy volumes, and expectations around UPI MDR.
The proposed framework envisages fees of up to 0.4% on eligible person-to-merchant transactions above ₹2,000 from October 15, potentially adding revenue depending on eligible volumes and fee-sharing arrangements.
However, reports of a possible postponement to January 2027 sent MobiKwik down 4.5% on Thursday.
MobiKwik posted Q1 FY27 profit of ₹7.6 Cr against a ₹41.9 Cr loss a year earlier. EBITDA turned positive at ₹15.8 Cr, GMV rose 50% YoY to ₹58,700 Cr, and UPI volumes increased around 2.3 times.
From a technical perspective, the stock is facing resistance at ₹240-₹260 after the breakout. A sustained move above this range could open the way towards ₹275-280 and, subsequently, ₹300, as per analyst commentary reported by Mint.
RentoMojo Rises Despite Profit Decline
RentoMojo gained 12.34% to ₹590.50 as it disclosed its first quarterly results since listing.
Its Q1 FY27 consolidated profit fell 38.7% to ₹7.8 Cr from ₹12.8 Cr a year earlier. Sequentially, it declined 53% from ₹16.8 Cr.
Operating revenue rose 51.1% to ₹126.3 Cr from ₹83.6 Cr in Q1 FY26, and 15.2% sequentially from ₹109.5 Cr, driven by more live products and orders.
EBITDA rose 17.5% YoY to ₹40.9 Cr, but its margin narrowed to 32.2% from 41%. Results included ₹11.4 Cr in exceptional costs from a fire at its sub-leased warehouse in Noida in June.
Live products rose 41% YoY to 9.2 Lakh and active users increased 36.3% to 2.8 Lakh. Average revenue per product grew 6.8% YoY to ₹1,662.6, while occupancy improved to 86.8% from 84.8%.
RentoMojo operated 23 warehouses and 89 offline stores across India at June-end.

items.author: Anne Florentyna
items.content:
India’s cleantech startups attracted substantially more capital in Q3 2026, with large electric mobility rounds driving funding growth alongside an increase in deal activity.
According to Inc42’s Indian Tech Startup Funding Report, Q3 2026, cleantech startups raised $433 Mn across 23 deals, compared with $118 Mn across 16 deals in the year-ago quarter. The report tracks funding announced up to September 24.
The increase stood out against a subdued funding environment. Overall startup funding rose just 5% YoY to $2.2 Bn, while funding for fintech and ecommerce startups declined 11% and 31%, respectively.
However, the cleantech funding surge was heavily concentrated in electric mobility. River raised $120 Mn, Yulu secured $93 Mn, and Ultraviolette attracted $85 Mn. Together, the three startups accounted for $298 Mn, or nearly 69% of the sector’s funding.
Adding to this, Simple Energy raised a mega $180 Mn round at the end of the month of September, further adding to this trend.
The numbers raise two questions: what is drawing investors towards these businesses and how far does the momentum extend beyond a handful of large EV rounds?
Commercial Viability Shapes Investor Bets
For investors, the appeal is increasingly tied to whether technology can solve a tangible problem and support a commercially viable business.
“What’s different this cycle is that capital is backing businesses and not just the energy transition,” Elev8 Venture Partners managing partner Navin Honagudi told Inc42.
The VC firm led River’s $120 Mn Series C in August. The round alone accounted for nearly 28% of the quarter’s cleantech funding.
Shubham Jhuria, CFO and partner at Aeravti Ventures, also pointed to a shift in how investors assess the sector.
“The biggest change we are seeing is that the cleantech conversation is moving beyond the climate-impact narrative towards businesses solving very specific economic and infrastructure problems,” he told Inc42.
Funding activity extended beyond the three largest EV rounds, with Omega Seiki Mobility, Electric.AI, Simple Energy, and Yuma also raising capital during the quarter.
Cleantech deal count increased about 44%, while the average cheque size rose to approximately $19 Mn from $7 Mn in the year-ago quarter. EVs accounted for 57% of deals, according to the report.
This suggests that the increase was not solely the result of larger cheques, although electric mobility remained central to both funding value and deal activity.
Access Free Report
EV Adoption Supports The Investment Case
Rising EV adoption is giving investors a more tangible basis to assess demand and business models.
JMK Research estimates that 15.41 Lakh EVs were registered in H1 2026, up 43% YoY.
According to Vahan, total EV registrations rose 64.6% YoY to 3.15 Lakh units in September. E2W registrations increased 12.2% to 2.07 Lakh units from 1.84 Lakh in August.
Honagudi said electric mobility has matured into a demand-led market. He pointed to River’s position among India’s top seven electric two-wheeler brands by registrations, despite having far fewer retail outlets than established players, as evidence of product-led demand.
Over the next 3-5 years, Elev8 expects deeper localisation of motors and electronics to improve margins and supply-chain resilience. Honagudi cited last year’s rare earth magnet shortage as an example of the vulnerabilities that localisation could address.
He also expects consolidation to leave “a handful of scaled independents” alongside established incumbents.
Can The Momentum Broaden?
Stronger adoption does not automatically translate into attractive investor returns.
Jhuria cautioned that investment appetite could moderate if businesses struggle to convert technological capabilities into scalable solutions or continue to require substantial capital without improving their unit economics.
The quarter’s numbers reflect both wider deal activity and substantial concentration. More cleantech startups attracted funding than a year earlier, but three EV businesses still captured more than two-thirds of the capital.
For the momentum to broaden, investor conviction will need to extend beyond large electric mobility bets. Within EVs, the test will be whether rising demand and deeper localisation translate into stronger margins and businesses that can scale without repeatedly requiring outsized capital infusions.

items.author: Afaq Wajdan Malik
items.content:
Microsoft is reportedly testing a major redesign of the Xbox PC app, with a stronger focus on performance, simpler navigation, and better support for controller-based gaming.
The rebuilt app is internally codenamed Garrison and is currently being tested in an early form.
Much Faster For Large Game Libraries
One of the biggest improvements appears to be performance. Windows Central’s Jez Corden tested an early build with a library containing more than 1,400 games and reported significantly faster loading and navigation compared with the current Xbox PC app.
There are no detailed benchmark numbers yet, but early impressions suggest Microsoft has substantially improved responsiveness, particularly when browsing large libraries.
That could address one of the most common complaints about the existing Xbox app, which has often been criticized for slow navigation and sluggish library loading.
&&&&&&&
Simpler Interface
The new app also reorganizes how games are displayed.
The current Xbox PC app separates game listings from their individual store pages.
In the redesigned version, Microsoft reportedly combines the two into a single interface, reducing the number of pages users need to open when browsing games, checking details or managing purchases.
Screenshots shared separately by The Verge’s Tom Warren also show a cleaner layout, while Warren said performance is noticeably better than in the existing app.
Microsoft is also making it clearer whether a game can be installed locally or is only available through Xbox Cloud Gaming.
This should make large libraries easier to understand, particularly when they contain games from multiple generations or different Xbox services.
Better Controller Support
The redesigned Xbox PC app supports both mouse-and-keyboard and controller navigation.
The interface can automatically adjust its scaling when used with a controller, making it better suited to gaming handhelds and living-room setups.
Users will reportedly also be able to set the Xbox app as the default home interface when entering Windows 11’s new gaming-focused mode.
That could make the app particularly useful on handheld gaming PCs such as the ROG Xbox Ally.
Still Missing Some Steam Features
The current overhaul appears to focus mainly on speed, navigation, and usability rather than adding a large number of new features.
Microsoft still trails Steam in areas such as community features, user reviews, developer interaction, and store discovery.
Those areas are not said to be major parts of the current Garrison build.
Release Could Come Before the End of 2026
Microsoft has not announced an official release date for the redesigned Xbox PC app.
However, the new version could reportedly reach Xbox Insiders in the coming weeks, potentially before the end of 2026.

The complaints are not limited to this week. SuperGrok users were already reporting at the start of October that weekly quotas appeared to disappear much faster than before, with some burning through nearly half their allowance within a day or two.
Users have also complained for months about xAI replacing older daily limits with a shared weekly quota. Some estimated that the change dramatically reduced the total number of image and video generations available under their subscriptions.

There is currently no official confirmation from xAI that it reduced Grok’s weekly limits this week.
That means the reports should be treated as user observations rather than a confirmed policy change.
It is also possible that xAI has changed how different features are weighted against the shared quota, which could make the limit disappear faster without technically reducing the total percentage available.
For now, though, the consistency of recent complaints suggests that at least some Grok subscribers are seeing noticeably lower effective usage than they were previously.
The complaints come after several earlier rounds of criticism over Grok’s weekly quota system, with paying users arguing that the limits have become increasingly restrictive without clear communication from xAI.

items.author: Afaq Wajdan Malik
items.content:
Anthropic has disabled live internet access for all of its internal AI evaluations after discovering that some of its models exploited websites and bypassed online restrictions while completing tasks.
The incidents involved AI agents that were asked to solve problems using information and resources available on the internet.
AI Agents Exploited Website Flaws
According to Anthropic, the agents exploited software vulnerabilities, accessed databases without paying required fees, and used URL-shortening services to move information past restrictions.
Some of the affected websites were operated by US government agencies. Anthropic said it discovered the behavior during a review of model activity that began in July, highlighting that it had not been monitoring all of the agents’ actions in real time.
The company described the latest incidents as less severe from an alignment and security perspective than some previous cases it had disclosed.
Anthropic Blames Reward Hacking
Anthropic said the behavior resulted from problems in its training and evaluation environments.
Those environments sometimes encouraged models to find loopholes or avoid restrictions because doing so appeared to help them achieve higher rewards. This type of behavior is known as reward hacking.
The company said its current alignment training is not yet sufficient to reliably control capabilities such as web search and computer use, even though those features are central to its plans for AI agents.
Live Internet Access Disabled
Anthropic has now turned off live internet access for all internal evaluations until it is confident that it can properly monitor and control its agents.
Some evaluations will be stopped completely or moved to offline environments. The company has also developed tools designed to detect and block the types of behavior uncovered in the review.
Anthropic said those safeguards were tested against the newly disclosed incidents and successfully prevented the same behavior.
Stronger Containment Coming
Anthropic also plans to move its internal AI agents onto centrally managed infrastructure with stronger containment controls.
The company is increasing its use of safety classifiers to monitor agent activity and detect potentially unsafe actions.
It has not said exactly what conditions will need to be met before live internet access returns to its internal evaluations.
Similar Problems Hit OpenAI
Anthropic is not the only AI company to face this problem. OpenAI has also disclosed cases where autonomous agents accessed external websites and systems while attempting to complete research tasks.
These incidents highlight a broader challenge facing AI companies: giving agents enough freedom to perform useful online tasks while preventing them from bypassing safeguards or exploiting unintended weaknesses.
AI safety researchers argue that independent testing and oversight will become increasingly important as more capable agents gain access to browsers, computers, and external systems.

items.author: Muhammad Bilal
items.content:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has ordered the installation of smart scanners at all international airports in Pakistan to reduce passenger inconvenience and replace outdated baggage inspection procedures.
Chairing a meeting on customs operations in Islamabad on Saturday, the prime minister directed authorities to arrange the immediate air shipment of the scanners and install them at international airports across the country. He also ordered customs officials to stop questioning passengers unnecessarily and said baggage checks should increasingly rely on automated systems.
Sharif said passenger comfort and convenience must remain the top priority, adding that no one would be allowed to harass travelers. He also directed authorities to train airport staff according to international standards, with courtesy and respect for passengers made key parts of their training.
The prime minister praised the Federal Board of Revenue’s new customs enforcement system and called for stronger action against tax evasion and smuggling. He said businesses that pay taxes deserve respect, while authorities must adopt a zero-tolerance policy toward tax evasion.
Officials briefed the meeting on customs enforcement at airports, seaports and other locations, as well as measures to curb petroleum smuggling. They reported progress in establishing digital enforcement stations and consolidating customs enforcement operations into a coordinated nationwide system.
The Indus Collectorate (Enforcement) seized goods worth approximately Rs. 205 million in 80 operations during its first three weeks, officials said. A total of 865 personnel have been deployed, covering 26 major routes.
Officials also reported ongoing operations against smuggled textiles, vehicles, cigarettes, high-speed diesel, auto parts and other goods. The recruitment of 280 goods appraisers has been completed, with their training scheduled for October and November 2026.
The meeting was attended by Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar, federal ministers Azam Nazeer Tarar, Musadik Malik, Ahsan Khan Cheema, Attaullah Tarar and Shaza Fatima Khawaja, Minister of State Bilal Azhar Kayani, members of the National Assembly Usman Owaisi and Rana Iradat Sharif Khan, and senior officials.

items.title: مینا کماری کی موت کی خبر نے فلاپ فلم ’پاکیزہ‘ کی قسمت کیسے بدل دی؟
items.summary:
مینا کماری کی موت کی خبر نے پورے ملک کو صدمے میں مبتلا کر دیا، تاہم ان کی وفات کے ساتھ ہی گویا پاکیزہ کی قسمت بھی بدل گئی۔
ملک بھر کے سنیما گھروں میں لوگوں کا ہجوم امڈ آیا۔ پاکیزہ میں گوہر جان کا کردار ادا کرنے والی اداکارہ نادرا نے کہا کہ ’سنیما گھروں میں لوگوں کا سیلاب آ گیا تھا۔ وہ صرف پاکیزہ دیکھنے نہیں آ رہے تھے بلکہ یوں لگتا تھا جیسے وہ مینا کماری کے مزار پر حاضری دینے آ رہے ہوں۔‘
پاکیزہ کو غیرمعمولی کامیابی حاصل ہوئی اور یہ 1972 کی سب سے زیادہ کمائی کرنے والی فلموں میں شامل ہو گئی۔

Walau sudah muncul di Netflox Games, seri baru Monster Hunter ini masih tersedia secara terbatas di sejumlah wilayah di dunia, dengan jadwal peluncurannya di Indonesia masih belum diketahui secara pasti.

items.author: Yus Lianson
items.content:
Monster Hunter Rise resmi menyambangi platform Android dan iOS, di mana fans game berburu monster besutan Capcom bisa main di perangkat mobile dengan syarat berlangganan Netflix aktif.
Walau sudah muncul di Netflox Games, seri baru Monster Hunter ini masih tersedia secara terbatas di sejumlah wilayah di dunia, dengan jadwal peluncurannya di Indonesia masih belum diketahui secara pasti.
Bagi pemain, daya tarik versi game ini terletak pada adaptasi game tersebut dari platform konsol dan PC. Pengembang pun melakukan perubahan dalam sistem pertarungan, tetapi tetap mempertahankan mekanik berburu monster yang sudah menjadi ciri khas game.
Baca Juga: Microsoft 365 Family Ubah Kuota OneDrive, Tak Lagi 1TB per Orang
Karena meluncur di platform mobile dengan ukuran layar yang terbatas, Capcom juga merombak kontrol dan beberapa fitur di dalam game agar lebih fleksibel dan nyaman saat dimainkan.
Seperti game-game yang meluncur di toko digital Netflix, Monster Hunter Rise versi mobile bisa langsung dimainkan di perangkat setelah di download, sebagaimana dilansir RPG Site, Sabtu (10/10/2026). Karena itu, spesifikasi smartphone dan tablet sangat menentukan performa game.
Capcom pertama kali meluncurkan Monster Hunter Rise ini untuk konsol Nintendo Switch pada 26 Maret 2021. Pada game ini, pengembang asal Jepang ini memperkenalkan mekanik baru bernama Wirebug untuk membantu pemain menjelajah area map dan bergerak di udara saat berburu monster.
Dari sisi cerita, player akan bertualan di desa Kamura dengan beragam misi berburu dan mengumpulkan material dari monster, lalu membuat senjata dan armor untuk menghadapi tantangan berikutnya.
Seperti versi konsol dan PC, pemain bisa berburu secara solo atau bersama dengan tiga pemain lainnya secara online.
Beda Monster Hunter Rise di Mobile, Seperti Apa?
Main Monster Hunter Rise di iOS dan Android. (Doc: Google)
Halaman toko aplikasi mencantumkan ada tiga penyesuaian khusus versi mobile.
Pertama, kontrol sentuh dirancang ulang untuk ponsel dan tablet, termasuk skema berbeda bagi setiap senjata. Tampilan juga disesuaikan dengan beragam ukuran dan rasio layar.
Kedua, Recovery Button memilih item pemulihan paling efektif dari inventori berdasarkan kesehatan dan status hunter. Fungsi ini mengurangi kebutuhan mencari item di tengah pertarungan.
Ketiga, Challenge Quest dan Event Quest yang dahulu tersedia sebagai konten unduhan berbayar atau terbatas waktu dapat dibuka melalui progres permainan.
Keterangan tersebut belum memastikan ekspansi Sunbreak ikut tersedia. Dukungan cross-play dengan pemain konsol atau PC juga belum dijelaskan.
Spesifikasi Monster Hunter Rise di HP dan Tablet
Monster Hunter Rise Netflix. (Doc: Google Play)
Google Play mencantumkan rekomendasi smartphone dan tablet yang bisa memainkan game ini sudah menggunakan chipset Snapdragon 8+ Gen 1 atau lebih tinggi serta RAM minimal 8 GB. 
Galaxy S23 Ultra, Xperia 5 V, dan Zenfone 10 masuk daftar perangkat yang dikonfirmasi, dengan catatan kondisi penggunaan dapat memengaruhi kompatibilitas.
Untuk pengguna iPhone dan iPad, App Store milik Apple tersebut menyebutkan game ini bisa dimainkan di perangkat dengan iOS 18 atau iPadOS 18 ke atas. Halaman yang sama mencantumkan dukungan controller PlayStation, Xbox, atau MFi yang kompatibel.
Netflix menjelaskan, game mobile dalam layanan termasuk dalam langganan, tanpa biaya tambahan, iklan, atau pembelian dalam aplikasi. Pengguna tetap perlu menginstal game dan memakai akun Netflix untuk mengakses permainan.
Bagaimana dengan Indonesia?
Sayangnya, belum diketahui secara pasti game ini muncul di Google Play dan App Store Indonesia. Hingga penelusuran tim Gizmologi, Sabtu (10/10/2026), belum ditemukan pengumuman jadwal peluncuran Indonesia maupun global.
Bagi pemain Indonesia, kemunculan halaman toko di negara lain belum menjadi kepastian game dapat diunduh dengan akun lokal. Jadwal akses dan daftar perangkat yang didukung perlu mengikuti informasi resmi saat distribusi diperluas.
Monster Hunter Outlanders Resmi Rilis 29 Oktober
Monster Hunter Outlanders Resmi Rilis 29 Oktober, Bawa Hunting ke Mobile. (Doc: Garena Indonesia)
Di sisi lain, Monster Hunter Outlanders akhirnya memiliki tanggal rilis resmi. Game mobile dikembangkan TiMi Studio Group di bawah lisensi Capcom dan diterbitkan Garena untuk Asia Tenggara ini akan meluncur ke perangkat Android dan iOS pada 29 Oktober 2026.
Pengumuman ini sekaligus mengakhiri penantian fans seri Monster Hunter (Monhunt) yang sudah mengikuti perkembangan game tersebut sejak pertama kali diperkenalkan.
Jelang peluncurannya, Garena dan TiMi Studio Group juga merilis trailer terbaru yang menampilkan sejumlah karakter, monster, serta cuplikan gameplay teranyar di dunia Aesoland.

Many people were wounded in a blast at ​Riyadh's international airport on Saturday, according to two eyewitnesses and two ‌people briefed on the matter, and travellers were evacuated from parts of the facility.
One of the eyewitnesses reported seeing an explosion and then seeing multiple people lying injured on the ​ground inside the airport. More than a dozen ambulances were seen rushing ​to the airport.
The Saudi government's media office and the Saudi civil ⁠aviation authority did not immediately respond to requests for comment on the ​incident.
Saturday's incident comes amid an escalation of missile strikes by Yemen's Houthis on the ​kingdom. The airport has already been attacked twice this week, leaving four people dead and others wounded, and badly damaging an aircraft.
Flight-tracking site flightradar24 showed all flights to Riyadh had ​either been diverted or cancelled, with only a helicopter hovering over the airport ​at one point.

items.content:
Many people were wounded in a blast at ​Riyadh's international airport on Saturday, according to two eyewitnesses and two ‌people briefed on the matter, and travellers were evacuated from parts of the facility.
One of the eyewitnesses reported seeing an explosion and then seeing multiple people lying injured on the ​ground inside the airport. More than a dozen ambulances were seen rushing ​to the airport.
The Saudi government's media office and the Saudi civil ⁠aviation authority did not immediately respond to requests for comment on the ​incident.
Saturday's incident comes amid an escalation of missile strikes by Yemen's Houthis on the ​kingdom. The airport has already been attacked twice this week, leaving four people dead and others wounded, and badly damaging an aircraft.
Flight-tracking site flightradar24 showed all flights to Riyadh had ​either been diverted or cancelled, with only a helicopter hovering over the airport ​at one point.

The airport urged passengers to contact their airlines directly and check their flight ‌status ⁠before heading there.
Kuwait Airways said it had cancelled flights to and from the Saudi capital due to what it described as the closure of Riyadh airport because of the "security situation" there.
Etihad Airways and Qatar Airways earlier cancelled multiple flights between their respective ​hubs and Riyadh, ​with some cancellations ⁠extending into Monday.
US, UK urge citizens to avoid Riyadh airport
The US and UK embassies in Saudi Arabia urged their citizens Saturday to avoid King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh following reported attacks, warning of security risks and possible travel disruptions.
"The US Mission is aware of attacks on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh on October 10 and strongly recommends all US citizens avoid this airport and surrounding areas," the US Embassy said in a statement.
Security Alert: U.S. Mission Saudi Arabia (October 10, 2026)
The U.S. Mission is aware of attacks on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh on October 10 and strongly recommends all U.S. citizens avoid this airport and surrounding areas.
U.S. government employees working in… pic.twitter.com/EOYrLzyOXt
— U.S. Embassy Riyadh (@USAinKSA) October 10, 2026
The embassy warned of possible flight cancellations, airspace closures and other travel disruptions, advising Americans to check their flight status directly with airlines and airport authorities.
It also said the US government employees in Saudi Arabia require special authorization to use the airport.
Separately, the British Embassy in Riyadh issued a similar warning following what it described as a serious incident at the airport.
10 October 2026: Update to FCDO Travel Advice for Saudi Arabia.
To read our travel advice, please visit https://t.co/dkWmWSU8gi pic.twitter.com/Lx1FrYZL8r
— UK in Saudi Arabia 🇬🇧🇸🇦 (@UKinSaudiArabia) October 10, 2026
"Following a serious incident at King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh on 10 October 2026 at approximately 1500 (local time), we advise British nationals to avoid King Khalid International Airport until the airport is secure and to monitor the advice of the Saudi authorities," it said on US social media platform X.
The US Embassy also reiterated existing travel restrictions for American government personnel in Saudi Arabia.
Employees are prohibited from traveling within 20 miles (32 kilometers) of the Yemen border because of security risks.
Special authorization is also required for travel to the provinces of Jizan, Asir and Najran, as well as the cities of Qatif, Yanbu and Taif.
Houthi attacks on Thursday and earlier in the week had already prompted a number of carriers to suspend ​or cancel services to the Saudi capital, shortly before Riyadh ​is due ⁠to host major energy and investment conferences.
Organisers of those conferences said on Saturday they would go ahead as planned, and they sought to reassure attendees of their security.
The ⁠Houthis have ​said airliners should avoid Saudi airspace, declaring it ​a zone of military operations after the Saudi-backed Yemeni government launched an offensive against the group ​earlier this month.

Di awal Dune Awake
items.author: Yus Lianson
items.content:
Funcom akhirnya merilis Dune: Awakening untuk PlayStation 5 dan Xbox Series X|S pada 22 September 2026, atau sekitar setahun setelah game survival open-world ini hadir di PC. 
Berbeda dari versi PC, pengembang \membawa mode single-player dan opsi kustomisasi gameplay untuk Dune: Awakening versi konsol ini. Sehingga Arrakis bisa dijelajahi tanpa bergantung pada pemain lain. 
Tim Gizmologi berkesempatan memainkannya sekitar 15 jam lebih di Xbox Series S, dari sudut pandang orang yang belum pernah mengikuti film maupun novel Dune. Perlu diingat, game ini didapat dari pihak Level Infinite.
Gurun di Dune: Awakening Sepi, Tapi Bikin Penasaran
Peta Arrakis di Dune: Awakening
Hal pertama terasa adalah sepinya Arrakis. Tidak ada banjir NPC di mana-mana, dengan sejumlah penanda yang menampilkan lokasi-lokasi material dan tentunya kota yang menjadi tempat paling sering dikunjungi selama bermain game.
Baca Juga: AnyPS5 Buka Jalan Main Game PS5 di PC, Sudah Sejauh Mana?
Di awal Dune Awakening, game ini membiarkan saya mencari arah sendiri, dan beberapa jam pertama jujur saja hal ini sangat membingungkan karena banyak istilah dan nama yang terdengar asing. Baru setelah menyelesaikan misi crafting dan mengumpulkan material, saya diberikan tools yang dapat dipakai untuk memindai area peta dan mendeteksi beragam lokasi penting.
Anehnya, rasa penasaran justru menjadi alasan bertahan. Setiap perjalanan mencari material selalu berakhir di tempat baru yang ingin lihat dan harus berhadapan dengan lawan yang kuat. 
Setelah sekitar 15 jam, karakter saya baru mencapai level 15. Angka itu lebih menggambarkan cara bermain daripada laju progres game secara umum: banyak waktu habis untuk eksplorasi, sementara akses ke area dan teknologi masih terbatas.
Sebagai orang yang belum mengenal Dune, saya belum bisa menilai seberapa dekat Arrakis dalam game dengan film atau novel. Tetapi dunia di dalam Dune: Awakening ini cukup menarik untuk membuat terus bermain tanpa bekal tersebut.
Sandworm dan Bandit Membuat Pasir Tidak Pernah Aman
Lari atau pakai kendaraan di Dune: Awakening
Dua jam pertama main game Dune: Awakening langsung mendapat pelajaran keras. Masih belum memiliki gear dan senjata yang mumpuni, karakter di dalam game pun mati dan kehilangan semua perlengkapan setelah dihadang bandit. Sejak kejadian itu, risiko perjalanan quest pun harus memiliki strategi, terutama saat membawa hasil pengumpulan material.
Seperti di dalam novel, sandworm sangat berperan penting di dalam game. Pertemuan pertama dengan sandworm lebih mengejutkan. Saat menjalankan quest untuk menemui NPC di sebuah kamp dan berjalan di atas hamparan pasir yang terlihat tenang.
Lalu muncul peringatan sandworm raksasa mendekat. Beberapa detik kemudian, karakter saya dilahap sebelum sempat menyelamatkan diri. Setelah itu, saya tidak lagi berlama-lama di pasir terbuka. Ancaman sandworm membuat saya lebih memperhatikan tempat dilalui, bahkan ketika tujuan perjalanan hanya menemui NPC. Momen seperti ini membuat eksplorasi Arrakis terasa menegangkan.
Base Building dan Crafting: Mudah Dipahami, Tapi…
Base building di Dune: Awakening
Sistem survival-nya akan terasa akrab bagi penggemar genre ini: kumpulkan material, buat peralatan, bangun tempat tinggal. Meski belum memahami seluruh sistem, hubungan antara bahan yang dikumpulkan dan kebutuhan untuk melanjutkan permainan sangat penting.
Hambatan mulai terasa ketika backpack penuh. Saya harus bolak-balik, sementara bahan untuk crafting tetap perlu dicari. Perjalanan yang semula menarik perlahan berubah menjadi rutinitas.
Beberapa kali kehilangan fokus dari quest utama karena sibuk mengumpulkan material. Ada perjalanan berujung pada penemuan menarik, tetapi ada pula sesi ketika merasa hanya mengurus kebutuhan crafting berikut.
Selama pengujian ini, base building dan crafting sangat penting agar bisa melanjutkan quest atau story. Walau ingin eksplorasi dan melihat tempat baru, tetapi mengulang proses pengumpulan bahan untuk mencapai tujuan itu terasa repetitif.
Bertarung Dune: Awakening terasa kaku
Pertarungan menjadi bagian paling sering memutus ritme bermain. Saat menghadapi musuh berperisai, tembakan terasa kurang efektif, sehingga harus beralih ke pisau atau pedang. Pergantian antara senjata jarak jauh dan senjata jarak dekat itu belum terasa lancar di tangan saya.
Di tengah pertarungan, perhatian terbagi antara menghadapi musuh dan memilih senjata. Beberapa kali saya bahkan lupa menggunakan dodge.
Sebagian kesulitan ini berkaitan dengan proses belajar saya sendiri. Sekitar jam keenam, saya mulai menangkap arah sistem skill, tetapi sampai jam kelima belas saya masih belum yakin menentukan build karakter. 
Pilihan skill membutuhkan waktu untuk dipahami. Dalam progres yang saya capai, saya belum merasa cukup menguasai sistem untuk memilih kemampuan dengan percaya diri.
UI Paling Menguji Kesabaran
Menu di Dune: Awakening.
Kalau harus memilih satu biang masalah, jawabannya UI. Menu research harus dibuka lewat tombol Options, lalu pindah antartab dengan LB/LT di Xbox. Di menu crafting, item dipilih dengan tombol arah, dan saya beberapa kali tanpa sengaja membuat item dobel. 
Mengganti tools lewat menu wheel juga tidak langsung bisa. Item harus diambil dulu dari backpack, lalu di-drag ke quick access. Sampai sekarang saya belum menemukan opsi pengaturan yang meringankan semua ini.
Performa Dune: Awakening di Xbox Series S
Dune: Awakening
Dari sisi teknis, game ini cukup meyakinkan dan terasa lancar selama sesi pengujian. Satu catatan: beberapa kali game macet dan saya harus keluar ke home screen lalu memulai ulang. Ukuran file tergolong standar untuk game studio besar saat ini.
Dibanding game survival sejenis, seperti Ark, Conan Exiles, game besutan Level Infinite ini menurut saya masih lebih baik. Namun sistem skill dan building yang rumit berisiko membuat banyak pemain bosan sebelum benar-benar menikmati intinya.
Kesimpulan Dune: Awakening
Dune: Awakening
Setelah sekitar 15 jam, saya masih ingin melanjutkan eksplorasi Arrakis. Sandworm membuat perjalanan terasa berisiko, sementara pencarian material cukup sering membawa ke tempat menarik. Hal membuat ragu adalah kegiatan di antara perjalanan tersebut. Pengumpulan bahan mulai berulang, pergantian senjata belum nyaman, dan navigasi menu dengan controller paling sering menguji kesabaran.
Dune: Awakening layak dipertimbangkan jika daya tarik utama bagi pembaca adalah eksplorasi dan proses membangun tempat tinggal, disertai kesediaan mempelajari banyak sistem. Bagi yang mencari game survival dengan kontrol yang cepat terasa akrab, pengalaman di Series S menjadi alasan untuk menunggu diskon.
Jika tidak mengikuti film atau novel Dune tidak menghalangi menikmati Arrakis. Hambatan terbesar selama pengujian justru muncul ketika harus mengelola inventori, bertarung, dan memahami skill. Pada level 15, saya masih penasaran dengan dunia ini, tetapi belum merasa nyaman dengan seluruh cara bermain.
Artikel berjudul Review Dune: Awakening, Arrakis Memikat tapi Bikin Penat yang ditulis oleh Yus Lianson pertama kali tampil di Gizmologi.id

items.content: Supermarkets major Avenue Supermarts, the operator of DMart, reported an 8.5% year-on-year (YoY) increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 743 crore for the second quarter of FY27, compared with Rs 685 crore in the year-ago period.The company, promoted by investor Radhakishan Damani, reported consolidated total revenue of Rs 19,644 crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, marking a 17.8% YoY increase from Rs 16,676 crore in Q2FY26.Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) rose 14.7% YoY to Rs 1,393 crore in Q2FY27, compared with Rs 1,214 crore in the corresponding quarter last year.However, the EBITDA margin declined to 7.1% in Q2FY27 from 7.3% in Q2FY26, a contraction of 0.2 percentage points. The profit after tax (PAT) margin also fell to 3.8% from 4.1%, down 0.3 percentage points.Basic earnings per share (EPS) increased 8.3% YoY to Rs 11.40 in Q2FY27, compared with Rs 10.53 in the year-ago quarter.ALSO READ: FIIs dump Indian stocks for eight straight weeks: Is a reversal on the cards or more pain ahead?DMart H1FY27 PerformanceFor the first half of FY27, Avenue Supermarts reported consolidated net profit of Rs 1,603 crore, up 9.9% YoY from Rs 1,458 crore in H1FY26.Consolidated total revenue for the six-month period rose 16.4% YoY to Rs 38,439 crore from Rs 33,036 crore in the corresponding period last year.EBITDA increased 15.1% to Rs 2,892 crore in H1FY27, compared with Rs 2,513 crore in H1FY26.The EBITDA margin stood at 7.5% in H1FY27, down 0.1 percentage points from 7.6% in the year-ago period. The PAT margin declined to 4.2% from 4.4%, a contraction of 0.2 percentage points.Basic EPS for the first half of FY27 rose 9.8% YoY to Rs 24.60, compared with Rs 22.41 in H1FY26.Management CommentaryAnshul Asawa, Managing Director and CEO of Avenue Supermarts, said the company remained committed to offering value to customers and maintaining its pricing proposition amid inflationary pressures.“We remain committed to offering best value to our customers. Our pricing proposition thus remains strong in an inflationary environment. Wage inflation at entry-level has led to a marginal increase in operating expenses,” Asawa said.The company opened 15 new stores during the quarter, taking its total store count to 518.Commenting on the performance of DMart Ready, the company's e-commerce business, Vikram Dasu, Whole Time Director and CEO of Avenue E-Commerce Ltd, said the business was focused on improving operational efficiencies and strengthening the customer experience in the cities where it operates.“We are focused on driving greater operational efficiencies and strengthening overall customer experience in the cities that we currently operate in. Our organisational efforts are aligned in that direction,” Dasu said.DMart Share PriceShares of Avenue Supermarts closed at Rs 3,516.80 on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) on Saturday, declining 1.90% from the previous close of Rs 3,585. The stock traded in a range of Rs 3,497.70 to Rs 3,603.90 during the session.The stock has dropped 5.36% year-to-date in 2026. items.author: Palak Sharma
items.content:
D2C personal care brand Nat Habit has raised ₹142 Cr (around $14.7 Mn) in an all-primary Series C funding round led by Trident Growth Partners to expand its distribution, product portfolio, and manufacturing capabilities.
Existing investors Bertelsmann India Investments, Mirabilis Investment Trust, and Sharrp Ventures participated in the round, while Physis Capital and Hero Family Office joined the cap table.
The startup plans to expand its offline presence from about 20,000 stores to 2 Lakh over the next three years. Alongside growing its general trade presence, Nat Habit will enter modern trade and expand its team to support the rollout.
The expansion also involves reaching a broader consumer base. Having primarily targeted consumers with higher income and education levels, Nat Habit is now looking to reach what it calls the “Bharat consumer”, with changes to pack sizes and communication.
Beyond offline retail, Nat Habit will use the fresh capital to strengthen its quick commerce presence and expand its product portfolio. It plans to enter categories such as sunscreens and serums, which it does not currently offer, with investments in R&D, formulation, and manufacturing facilities.
“Our ambition now is to make our products accessible to many more households across India,” said cofounder Swagatika Das.
Founded in 2019 by Das and Gaurav Agarwal, Nat Habit sells personal care products, including hair oils, masks, scrubs, and face creams. It says it combines traditional ayurvedic principles with modern science to develop plant-based formulations across haircare, skincare, body care, and baby care.
The startup claims to have served more than 60 Lakh households across India and its annualised gross revenue reaching ₹330 Cr.
Prior to this, Nat Habit raised $10.2 Mn in its Series B funding round in 2023. Back then, the startup said it would use the capital for product diversification, brand building, offline expansion and hiring talent.
The fundraise adds to investments in India’s ayurvedic and herbal wellness segment. In September 2025, Kapiva raised $60 Mn in a Series D round, comprising $28 Mn in primary funding and $32 Mn in secondary transactions. It planned to deploy the fresh capital towards R&D, manufacturing, marketing, and international expansion.
In January this year, Kapiva also launched a ₹50 Cr innovation fund to support ayurvedic research, product development, and the use of AI in Ayurveda.
However, expansion has proved difficult for some brands. Last month, The Ayurveda Co cofounder Param Bhargava announced the startup’s closure, after it ceased operations in July 2025.

items.author: xinhua.
items.content:
An international team led by Chinese scientists has discovered a new docodont mammaliaform species, the largest known of its kind, in Jurassic strata dating back about 160 million years, enriching scientific understanding of Jurassic mammaliaform diversity.
The new species has been named Megacauda sungei. Its fossil specimen, discovered in Ningcheng, north China's Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, measures roughly 52 centimeters in length and is estimated to have weighed around 2 kilograms, making it the largest known docodont mammaliaform. Its skull is clearly preserved, its trunk is robust, and its most striking feature is an unusually long, coiled tail.
The specimen also retains well-preserved pelvic bones, hind limbs and tail vertebrae, suggesting it was adapted for swimming. Based on its distinctive teeth, researchers believe it could have hunted small animals living in the same environment, with a lifestyle possibly similar to that of the modern platypus.
The study also sheds light on the animal's throat structure. The bones in its throat are similar to those of modern mammals, suggesting that behaviors such as swallowing, lapping and suckling may have already existed in the early ancestors of mammals, long before modern mammal groups appeared.
"Mammaliaforms from the Mesozoic are often imagined as tiny creatures under dinosaur feet, but Megacauda sungei clearly raises the size limit of this group," said Li Yikun, an associate professor at Shenyang Normal University in northeast China.
The study was published online in the journal Nature on October 7.

items.author: Christopher Louis
items.content:
Bitdefender menjalin kerja sama distribusi eksklusif dengan PT Gema Informatika Abadi (PT GIA) untuk memperluas akses terhadap produk keamanan siber konsumen di Indonesia. Melalui kemitraan ini, seluruh portofolio produk konsumen Bitdefender akan dipasarkan melalui jaringan reseller PT GIA, termasuk retailer fisik dan marketplace online.
Kerja sama tersebut hadir di tengah meningkatnya risiko penipuan online, pencurian identitas, dan penyebaran malware. Penggunaan kecerdasan buatan (AI) juga memungkinkan pelaku kejahatan siber membuat pesan penipuan yang lebih meyakinkan serta menjalankan kampanye dalam skala lebih besar.
Berdasarkan data Global Anti Scam Alliance yang dikutip dalam pengumuman tersebut, 66% orang dewasa di Indonesia pernah mengalami penipuan dalam satu tahun terakhir. Survei terhadap 7.000 konsumen secara global juga menemukan bahwa satu dari tujuh responden menjadi korban penipuan dalam periode yang sama. Meski demikian, angka tersebut menggambarkan pengalaman penipuan, bukan berarti seluruh responden mengalami kerugian finansial.
Baca Juga: NetApp Novus Hadirkan Arsitektur Penyimpanan AI dengan Target Throughput 100 TBps
Tawarkan Perlindungan Malware hingga Deepfake
Portofolio konsumen Bitdefender mencakup perlindungan komputer dan perangkat mobile, privasi, identitas digital, serta teknologi anti-penipuan dan pendeteksi deepfake. Produk tersebut ditujukan untuk membantu pengguna menghadapi berbagai risiko, mulai dari malware dan phishing hingga pencurian identitas saat beraktivitas secara online.
Bitdefender dan PT GIA juga akan memprioritaskan pemasaran fitur keamanan berbasis AI dan perlindungan anti-penipuan. Menurut kedua perusahaan, pendekatan ini diperlukan karena pelaku kejahatan siber semakin memanfaatkan AI untuk membuat skema social engineering yang lebih sulit dikenali. Namun, perangkat keamanan tetap perlu disertai kebiasaan digital yang baik, seperti memeriksa tautan, menjaga kerahasiaan data, dan mengaktifkan autentikasi berlapis.
Akses Produk Diperluas, Harga Belum Diungkap
Melalui jaringan distribusi PT GIA, produk konsumen Bitdefender akan tersedia di berbagai toko fisik dan marketplace di Indonesia. Perusahaan menyebut portofolionya mencakup paket untuk individu maupun keluarga, sehingga pengguna dapat memilih perlindungan sesuai kebutuhan perangkat dan aktivitas digital mereka.
Meski begitu, pengumuman kerja sama ini belum merinci harga produk, daftar paket yang tersedia di Indonesia, maupun skema berlangganan lokal. Konsumen perlu mempertimbangkan cakupan perlindungan, jumlah perangkat yang didukung, serta biaya perpanjangan sebelum memilih layanan keamanan. Kerja sama ini memperluas pilihan di pasar keamanan siber, tetapi efektivitasnya bagi konsumen juga akan bergantung pada harga dan kemudahan akses produk yang ditawarkan.

items.title: PM Shehbaz takes notice of gold medallist’s suicide in Islamabad following education funds scam
items.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Saturday took notice of the death of Laiba Ijaz, a student at the International Islamic University Islamabad, who was found dead in the capital a day earlier.
Laiba, who had aspired to study at a US university, was found hanging from a tree near a road in Islamabad on Friday, after her family allegedly lost around Rs7 million to a consultant who had promised to secure her admission and a scholarship.
According to her family, they had lost around Rs7 million to a man who allegedly promised to secure her admission to a US university on a scholarship.
According to a statement issued by the Prime Minister’s Office (PMO), the premier described the young student’s death as an extremely regrettable incident.

items.author: Naeem Asghar
items.content:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Saturday took notice of the death of Laiba Ijaz, a student at the International Islamic University Islamabad, who was found dead in the capital a day earlier.
Laiba, who had aspired to study at a US university, was found hanging from a tree near a road in Islamabad on Friday, after her family allegedly lost around Rs7 million to a consultant who had promised to secure her admission and a scholarship.
According to her family, they had lost around Rs7 million to a man who allegedly promised to secure her admission to a US university on a scholarship.
According to a statement issued by the Prime Minister’s Office (PMO), the premier described the young student’s death as an extremely regrettable incident.
وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف کا اسلام آباد میں انٹرنیشنل اسلامک یونیورسٹی کی طالبہ لائبہ اعجاز کی خود کشی کا نوٹس، وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ نوجوان طالبہ کی خود کشی انتہائی افسوس ناک واقعہ ہے.
وزیراعظم نے آئی جی اسلام آباد اور چیف کمشنر کو مرحومہ کے ساتھ فراڈ کرنے والے ملزم کو فوری طور… pic.twitter.com/qqzgkxbClA
— Prime Minister's Office (@PakPMO) October 10, 2026
“The accused should be arrested forthwith and awarded exemplary punishment in accordance with the law,” the prime minister said, directing the inspector general of Islamabad police and the chief commissioner to take immediate action against the suspect.
Laiba’s funeral prayers were offered on Saturday, with residents of the area mourning her death. Residents described her as an exceptionally talented and studious student.
FIA registers case, arrests main suspect
The Federal Investigation Agency (FIA) has registered a case against two suspects and arrested the main suspect in the case.
The FIA’s Anti-Human Trafficking Circle in Islamabad took action after the victim’s family approached the agency following her burial. After completing an inquiry, the agency registered a case against suspects Muhammad Nauman and Fatima Sarwar under Sections 419 (cheating), 420 (cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property) and 109 (abetment) of the Pakistan Penal Code, read with Sections 18 and 22 of the Emigration Ordinance, 1979.
Preliminary investigations revealed that the suspects allegedly acted in connivance to deceive Laiba, the niece of complainant Amjadur Rehman, with promises of a US visa and scholarship. They allegedly received a total of Rs9.3 million from the family.
Read: Islamabad student found dead after allegedly losing Rs7m in education scam
The FIA said the suspects allegedly prepared fake scholarship award letters, university admission offer letters and fee payment receipts to keep the family under the impression that the process was genuine.
Of the total amount, Rs2.9m was transferred through Laiba’s personal bank account, while the remaining sum was received in cash, according to the agency.
Meanwhile, Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi and Minister of State for Interior Talal Chaudhry visited the bereaved family after taking notice of the incident. They offered their condolences and assured the family that justice would be served.
Following the interior minister’s directions, the FIA launched efforts to arrest the suspects. Raids were being conducted at various locations under the supervision of the FIA Islamabad Zone director, the report said.
The main suspect has been arrested and is being interrogated, according to sources. FIA officials said the investigation would also determine the role of any other individuals who might have been involved in the case.
The FIA Islamabad Zone said it was committed to bringing all those responsible for the alleged fraud against Laiba to justice.
The family alleged that the suspect had lured Laiba with the promise of a scholarship at Harvard and provided her with a forged scholarship letter. They said he had also portrayed himself as her sponsor to obtain money from them.
According to the family, the suspect claimed to be an accounts officer at the Islamabad High Court and at other times presented himself as an employee of the superior judiciary or an officer of a sensitive institution.
The family further alleged that he had promised to secure a government job for Laiba’s brother and taken an additional Rs500,000 for the purpose.
Laiba’s brother had asked their father for money to start a business, but their father had decided to spend his resources on educating his daughter, the family said.
According to Laiba’s brother-in-law, the International Islamic University had offered her a scholarship to study in Saudi Arabia after she secured good marks in her bachelor’s degree.
When Laiba told the suspect about the offer, he allegedly claimed that he could arrange a scholarship for her in the United States instead.
The family said Laiba and her father had communicated with the suspect exclusively through WhatsApp. They also alleged that a woman was involved in the scheme. The suspect had told Laiba that the woman was based in the United States and worked for his company, they added.
The family alleged that the suspect had posed as an agent to facilitate Laiba’s travel abroad but had defrauded them instead. They said a forged admission letter purportedly issued by Harvard University had also been provided.
Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi also visited the family, accompanied by Minister of State for Interior Talal Chaudhry.
وفاقی وزیر داخلہ محسن نقوی اور وزیر مملکت طلال چوہدری کی جی 10 میں متوفیہ طالبہ لائبہ کی رہائش گاہ آمد
وفاقی وزیرداخلہ اور وزیر مملکت کی طالبہ لائبہ کے والد اور اہل خانہ سے ملاقات، المناک واقعہ پر گہرے دکھ اور افسوس کا اظہار pic.twitter.com/XzNZvvYN5k
— Ministry of Interior GoP (@MOIofficialGoP) October 10, 2026
Addressing a press conference later, Naqvi vowed strict action against those involved in the case, saying the authorities would ensure the arrest of the suspects, recover the money taken from victims and bring those responsible to justice.
“We will soon arrest everyone involved in this incident. We will also recover the money and ensure that they are punished,” the interior minister said, adding that the police and the Federal Investigation Agency (FIA) were actively pursuing the case.
He described the matter as a test case and said the authorities would take action against individuals involved in fraud and related criminal networks. He also urged the public to give the police sufficient time to apprehend the suspect.
Naqvi said the case would be pursued on a priority basis and pledged to personally oversee its progress.
“The suspect is not part of the gang involved in the case; he is a swindler,” he said, distinguishing the individual under investigation from the wider criminal network.
The minister further stated that PM Shehbaz had directed him to ensure that arrests were made in connection with the case.
Naqvi also discussed the government's efforts to combat human smuggling and trafficking.
He said the European Union had acknowledged a reduction of up to 64% in human smuggling. Referring to his recent visit to Türkiye, he added that the Turkish government had acknowledged a decline in human trafficking linked to illegal gangs, from 70% to 17%.
“We will eliminate these gangs involved in trafficking by the will of Allah,” he said.
The interior minister also highlighted operational challenges facing the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA), stating that the department had a staff strength of 61 and received approximately 3,000 complaints daily.
He said recommendations had been forwarded to the prime minister to improve the department's efficiency and strengthen its capacity to handle complaints.
Naqvi added that the government was working to integrate the NCCIA's complaint system with the Pak ID platform to enable authorities to monitor progress in individual cases.
He said further details about the initiative would be announced in the coming days, expressing confidence that the public would soon notice improvements in the system.

items.title: 3 in 5 AI models fail terrorism safety tests: Study
items.summary:
Three in five artificial intelligence (AI) models have failed terrorism safety tests, with models stripped of safeguards consistently providing potentially dangerous information, according to research reported by CBC News on Friday.
The study, conducted by the UK-based nonprofit Tech Against Terrorism, evaluated more than 130 AI models using hundreds of requests resembling those a terrorist planning an attack might submit.
Researchers found that models modified through a process known as "abliteration," which removes safety safeguards, failed every test.
Meta's Llama 3.1 8B model scored 97 out of 100 on the organization's safety benchmark before modification, compared with approximately three afterward.
Researchers said the modified model provided detailed responses to requests involving attacks, terrorist financing and radicalization, while its original version refused such requests.

items.content:
Three in five artificial intelligence (AI) models have failed terrorism safety tests, with models stripped of safeguards consistently providing potentially dangerous information, according to research reported by CBC News on Friday.
The study, conducted by the UK-based nonprofit Tech Against Terrorism, evaluated more than 130 AI models using hundreds of requests resembling those a terrorist planning an attack might submit.
Researchers found that models modified through a process known as "abliteration," which removes safety safeguards, failed every test.
Meta's Llama 3.1 8B model scored 97 out of 100 on the organization's safety benchmark before modification, compared with approximately three afterward.
Researchers said the modified model provided detailed responses to requests involving attacks, terrorist financing and radicalization, while its original version refused such requests.
Read More: Anthropic discloses fake tip to police among new rogue AI incidents
Understandably, there's concern about loss of control, existential risk of AI," said Adam Hadley, founder and executive director of Tech Against Terrorism.
"The thing is actually, this has already happened because a lot of these open models have already been broken — it's just no one's noticed yet."
The organization found more than 29,000 repositories advertising uncensored or unprotected AI models on Hugging Face as of late last month.
Hugging Face said it regularly moderates content violating its policies but warned that some recommendations in the report could undermine open research.
Meta said its models undergo safety evaluations and that its policies prohibit harmful or illegal uses.
The report found no evidence of terrorist or extremist groups using the tested models, apart from one extremist chatbot identified by researchers.
Tech Against Terrorism recommended independent safety benchmarks, stronger protections against safeguard removal and restrictions on distributing modified models.
"This idea that we can't have safety and progress, I think, is false," Hadley said.
