items.author: Yus Lianson
items.content:
Oppo resmi memperkenalkan lini HP Android terbarunya, A7 Pro 5G dan A7 Pro Max 5G, di Indonesia pada Jumat (9/10/2026). Tampil sebagai lini A teranyar di pasaran, Oppo A7 Pro series ini menawarkan baterai berkapasitas besar hingga 10.000 mAh, kamera selfie ultrawide 50MP, serta perlindungan terhadap air dan debu.
Tak hanya itu, perusahaan juga menyematkan sejumlah fitur berbasis kecerdasan buatan (AI) di fotografi dan mengoptimalkan performa. Oppo memasarkan lini ini sebagai smartphone tangguh yang ditujukan untuk penggunaan jangka panjang, dengan harga mulai Rp 7.499.000 di Indonesia.
Baca Juga: Windows Search Dirombak Microsoft, Bisa Apa Selain Cari File di PC?
Dari kedua model yang diumumkan, Oppo A7 Pro Max 5G memiliki spesifikasi lebih tinggi, terutama dari sisi kapasitas baterai, layar, sistem pendingin, dan kamera utama.
Menurut Jiang Linlin, Chief Marketing Officer Oppo Indonesia, A7 Pro Series dikembangkan dengan fokus pada ketahanan perangkat dan kelancaran penggunaan dalam jangka panjang.
“Melalui Oppo A7 Pro Series ini, kami ingin menghadirkan smartphone yang memadukan ketangguhan dengan pengalaman penggunaan yang tetap mulus dalam jangka panjangi,” ujar Jiang Linlin, sebagaimana dikutip dari keterangan resminya, Sabtu (10/6/2026).
Ia menambahkan, “HP baru Oppo ini sudah dilengkapi kamera selfie 50MP Ultra-Wide AI Zoom, baterai berkapasitas besar, serta berbagai teknologi yang mendukung performa dan durabilitas, seri ini dirancang untuk menjadi partner andal bagi pengguna dalam bekerja, berkarya, bermain, maupun menikmati berbagai momen sehari-hari.”
Spesifikasi OPPO A7 Pro Max, Usung Baterai 10.000 mAh
Kapasitas baterai menjadi salah satu pembeda utama OPPO A7 Pro Series. Model reguler dibekali baterai 8.000 mAh, sedangkan A7 Pro Max membawa kapasitas 10.000 mAh.
Angka tersebut tergolong besar untuk ukuran smartphone modern, terutama bagi pengguna yang sering beraktivitas di luar ruangan atau tidak memiliki banyak kesempatan mengisi daya. 
Perusahaan asal China ini mengklaim baterai A7 Pro Max mampu bertahan hingga 30,9 jam untuk navigasi Google Maps, 14,7 jam panggilan video WhatsApp, dan 15 jam bermain Mobile Legends: Bang Bang.
Untuk pengisian daya, Oppo A7 Pro Max mendukung teknologi 80W SUPERVOOC. Sementara itu, kedua model dirancang untuk mempertahankan kesehatan baterai di atas 80 persen setelah 2.000 siklus pengisian penuh.
Selain baterai, kedua HP Android juga telah mendapatkan perlindungan air dan debu IP69K serta ketahanan benturan yang disebut Oppo memenuhi standar military-grade. Klaim ketahanan ini bukan berarti perangkat sepenuhnya kebal terhadap kerusakan akibat benturan atau paparan cairan.
Kamera Selfie 50MP dengan Sudut Pandang Lebih Luas
Oppo A7 Pro 5G. (Doc: Oppo)
Selain baterai besar, Oppo A7 Pro Series mengandalkan kamera depan 50MP Ultra-Wide AI Zoom dengan sudut pandang hingga 100 derajat.
Kamera ini dirancang agar pengguna dapat mengambil foto bersama lebih banyak orang tanpa harus menjauhkan smartphone terlalu jauh.
Ada pula fitur AI Auto Wide-Angle Switch yang dapat mendeteksi jumlah orang dalam bingkai. Sistem akan menggunakan pembesaran 1x untuk foto portrait dan beralih otomatis ke 0,6x ketika mengambil foto grup.
Fitur tersebut menjadi salah satu pendekatan perusahaan untuk mempermudah pengambilan foto tanpa pengguna harus mengganti sudut kamera secara manual.
Oppo juga menyertakan Natural Tone untuk pengolahan warna kulit, AI Portrait Glow untuk menyesuaikan pencahayaan, serta AI Popout dan AI Remix Collage untuk menyunting foto menjadi konten yang lebih kreatif.
Khusus A7 Pro Max, raksasa teknologi itu membekali ponselnya dengan kamera utama 50MP menggunakan sensor berukuran 1/2 inci dan optical image stabilization (OIS).
Menurut klaim perusahaan, sensor tersebut dapat menangkap cahaya hingga 70 persen lebih banyak dibandingkan generasi sebelumnya. OPPO juga menghadirkan Power Flash untuk membantu pemotretan dalam kondisi minim cahaya.
Performa dan Layar Oppo A7 Pro Series
Oppo A7 Pro 5G membawa layar AMOLED 6,57 inci dengan resolusi FHD+ dan refresh rate 120Hz. Model Pro Max memiliki layar lebih besar, yakni AMOLED 6,78 inci dengan resolusi 1,5K, refresh rate 120Hz, dan tingkat kecerahan puncak yang diklaim mencapai 1.800 nits.
Dari sisi performa, perusahaan memberikan sejumlah teknologi pengoptimalan yang berbeda pada kedua model. A7 Pro 5G dilengkapi NetworkBoost Chip S1 dengan AI LinkBoost 4.0 untuk membantu penerimaan sinyal, serta AI GameBoost 3.0 dan sistem pendingin Glacier VC Vapor Chamber seluas 4.300 mm.
Sementara itu, A7 Pro Max menggunakan sistem pendingin SuperCool Vapor Chamber seluas 5.000 mm² dan teknologi Dual-Chip Smoothness Enhancements yang menggabungkan NetworkBoost Chip S1 dengan Touch Response Chip.
Kombinasi tersebut diklaim membantu menjaga respons layar dan kestabilan koneksi ketika pengguna bermain game maupun menjalankan aplikasi berat.
Perusahaan juga menyatakan A7 Pro Series telah melewati pengujian 6-Year Smoothness Test. Pengujian tersebut menjadi dasar klaim kelancaran jangka panjang perusahaan, tetapi tidak otomatis menjamin setiap perangkat akan memiliki performa identik setelah enam tahun pemakaian.
Untuk desain, A7 Pro tersedia dalam tiga warna, yaitu Surfing Blue, Bloom Pink, dan Shine Titanium. Sementara A7 Pro Max ditawarkan dalam Surfing Blue dan Lunar Black.
Model Pro Max juga memiliki Multi-Color Breathing Light di bagian belakang yang berfungsi sebagai indikator notifikasi.
Harga OPPO A7 Pro dan A7 Pro Max di Indonesia
Oppo A7 Pro Series 5G sudah tersedia melalui kanal penjualan resmi di Indonesia, termasuk OPPO Online Store, OPPO Official Store di Shopee dan TikTok Shop, serta toko mitra resmi.
Berikut harga resminya:
OPPO A7 Pro 5G
RAM 6GB / 128GB: Rp7.499.000
RAM 6GB / 256GB: Rp7.999.000
OPPO A7 Pro Max 5G
RAM 8GB / 128GB: Rp9.999.000
RAM 8GB / 256GB: Rp10.999.000
Perusahaan turut menawarkan sejumlah program pembelian, termasuk peningkatan kapasitas penyimpanan dari 128GB menjadi 256GB pada penawaran tertentu, cashback tukar tambah, dan perlindungan kesehatan baterai.

items.author: Reuters
items.content:
An Anthropic artificial intelligence model submitted a ​false homicide tip to a Philadelphia police website, among a string of incidents the AI company disclosed on Friday detailing ‌Claude models' unsanctioned manipulation of some government websites.
It is the first known instance in which a rogue AI appears to have tried to communicate a bogus tip to authorities, despite instructions not to create accounts or submit anything destructive, while not explicitly barred from submitting forms.
The cases are the latest examples of rogue or undesired behavior by the AI ​models of tech companies such as Anthropic and OpenAI.
They add fuel to national concerns about the fast-advancing technology amid reports of corporate ​network hacks by AI agents, and researchers' warnings of an eventual existential threat to humanity.
Many of the cases Anthropic ⁠revealed involved websites run by federal, state and local agencies. Anthropic said it briefed the White House and notified all the agencies involved, but ​did not disclose who those parties were.
"Super intelligence companies must immediately disclose incidents involving their models and follow with swift, decisive action to remedy any ​and all harm," FTC Director of Public Affairs Joe Gabriel Simonson said on X.
“Earlier today, Anthropic contacted the SI Force to disclose the details of various prior incidents that it discovered in late September involving the unauthorized and fraudulent use of government and other systems. The company informed us that these events occurred in the past,…
— Joe Gabriel Simonson (@SaysSimonson) October 9, 2026
This process was "not optional," he said, adding that the Super Intelligence Force would fulfill its responsibility.
The FTC said Anthropic disclosed to the SI Force on Friday its late September discovery of incidents involving what the task force called "unauthorized and fraudulent use of government and ​other systems".
Tip attributed to automated test process
On Friday, Philadelphia police said Anthropic notified them of the spurious tip this week, and attributed the submissions ​to an automated testing process.
"The two-month delay in detecting and reporting the incident to the city is unacceptable," they said.
The July 18 tip purported to come from someone ‌who might ⁠have information about the case, police added.
"I may have information regarding this case," Anthropic's model wrote in its submission.
"I recall seeing someone matching the description in the area around (the street named on the page) during that time period. Please contact me if this information is relevant." The brackets featured in Anthropic's statement.
Previous incidents have involved AI agents hacking into vulnerable systems or commandeering unsanctioned platforms to communicate with one another.
Read More: China vows to curb tech bubbles, keep AI risks in check
In September, Anthropic rival OpenAI apologized for ​the hacking of an Australian health ​data portal by a rogue ⁠AI agent, the first known instance of an AI agent exploiting a government website.
A bogus tip
In two cases described on Friday, Anthropic’s models obtained for free public data normally only available for a fee. Another instanced revealed an ​obscure flaw that allowed use of a public tool hosted by a university.
Claude models were also able to ​bypass restrictions by ⁠using free services that shorten URLs.
Philadelphia police said the tip "was flagged as spam and was never forwarded to the Real-Time Crime Center for investigative vetting or dissemination."
Knowingly giving false reports to law enforcement authorities is a misdemeanor under Pennsylvania law, which specifies "a person", however.
This includes "information relating to an offense or incident when he ⁠knows he ​has no information relating to such offense or incident."
Police quoted Anthropic as telling them the ​test process was stopped after discovery of the incident. The false tip was submitted through PhillyUnsolvedMurders.com concerning an unsolved homicide.
Police said they had no evidence of unauthorized access to their systems ​or compromise of their data.

items.author: Web Desk
items.content:
Federal Information Minister Attaullah Tarar on Saturday accused the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) government in Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa (K-P) of neglecting governance and prioritising efforts to secure the release of the party’s incarcerated founder over public welfare, development and security.
“The hours that should have been spent on governance have instead been spent plotting to secure the release of a prisoner,” Tarar said at a press conference in Islamabad, attended by Prime Minister’s Coordinator on Information for Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Affairs Ikhtiar Wali Khan and K-P MPA Jalal Khan.
Targeting K-P Chief Minister Sohail Afridi, Tarar alleged that the provincial leadership had devoted insufficient time to governance despite more than 13 years of PTI rule in the province.
“If you do the calculations, you will find that Sohail Afridi has devoted virtually zero hours to governance,” Tarar said, alleging that the chief minister’s administration had prioritised political agitation over addressing public grievances.
Tarar said the provincial government should have focused on establishing modern IT centres, building universities and schools, upgrading hospitals and improving public infrastructure across the province, including in Lakki Marwat, Mardan, Nowshera and Swabi.
Read: PTI terms proposed emergency in 12 K-P districts violation of 18th Amendment as long march enters seventh day
Comparing the provincial administration’s performance with that of the federal government, Tarar cited Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif’s inauguration of an IT park and the federal fuel subsidy scheme as examples of governance and public relief.
وزیر اطلاعات عطاء اللہ تارڑ، وزیراعظم کے کوآرڈینیٹر اختیار ولی خان، رکن اسمبلی خیبر پختونخوا جلال خان کی نیوزکانفرنس pic.twitter.com/v1EZHrVpJp
— PTV News (@PTVNewsOfficial) October 10, 2026
According to Tarar, the IT park would support start-ups, improve digital skills and contribute to economic growth. He also claimed that 10 million people had benefited from the fuel subsidy scheme through an IT-based registration system. He also said the federal government had incorporated public feedback into the subsidy scheme, including changes to eligibility requirements, arguing that the initiative demonstrated the importance of administrative follow-up and responsiveness to citizens.
He alleged that successive PTI governments had undermined K-P’s standing as a peaceful destination and failed to deliver adequate public services.
Tarar accuses PTI of failing to tackle terrorism
Tarar accused the PTI leadership of adopting a soft approach towards the banned Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), alleging that terrorists had been brought back to areas where security forces had previously restored peace through operations, including Zarb-e-Azb and Radd-ul-Fasaad.
The information minister claimed that the return of militants had contributed to renewed insecurity in parts of the province and accused the provincial leadership of failing to take a sufficiently forceful stand against terrorist groups.
Referring to attacks in Kohat, Hangu and Dera Ismail Khan, Tarar alleged that the provincial government had failed to respond effectively to the security situation.
He also referred to the killing of police personnel and civilians, including a child in an incident at the Aman Mela checkpoint in Dera Ismail Khan, and questioned the provincial leadership’s responsibility for protecting citizens.
Tarar further alleged that the provincial administration had failed to invest adequately in the police and Counter Terrorism Department (CTD). He said the government should have strengthened security infrastructure and installed Safe City surveillance cameras, particularly at entry and exit points in the merged tribal districts.
The minister alleged that funds allocated for development and security had instead been spent on political protests and agitation.
Tarar said the people of KP were suffering from poverty, inadequate healthcare, limited educational opportunities and insecurity, which he attributed to the provincial government’s failure to fulfil its responsibilities.
Speaking after Tarar, Prime Minister’s Coordinator on Information for Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Affairs Ikhtiar Wali Khan alleged that the PTI government had failed to deliver on its promises of educational development during more than a decade in power.
Wali claimed that at least 18 of the province’s 34 universities were on the verge of bankruptcy and that many institutions were operating without vice chancellors.
He challenged PTI leaders to substantiate their claims about establishing new universities, alleging that one institution cited by a provincial minister had yet to be built despite claims that students were already attending classes.
Wali said he had been carrying documents relating to the project for four months and challenged the minister concerned to debate the matter publicly.
Turning to the merged tribal districts, Wali alleged that little progress had been made in establishing new schools, colleges and police stations since their integration into K-P.
“Dedicated funds had been promised for the development of the former tribal areas at the time of their merger with the province. However, money transferred during the government of former prime minister Imran Khan had been diverted towards other constituencies and political activities instead of being spent in the designated areas,” Wali maintained.
He also alleged that public funds had been used to finance social media operations, claiming that thousands of social media influencers had received monthly payments. Wali did not present independently verified evidence of the alleged expenditure at the press conference.
The PML-N leader also assailed the province’s healthcare system and said it had deteriorated under successive PTI governments and required extensive reform.
He criticised the role of Dr Nausherwan Burki, whom he identified as Imran Khan’s cousin and an influential figure in the province’s healthcare system.
Wali highlighted that financial interests had influenced the approval of medicines and the inclusion of hospitals in the Sehat Card programme.
He claimed that only 20 to 40 hospitals out of approximately 100 were included on the relevant panel, adding that hospitals had been charged “fees for inclusion” and “monthly commissions linked to their profits”.
The PM’s aide also accused the provincial administration of neglecting the police and CTD, alleging that they had been deprived of essential weapons and resources despite federal funds being allocated for counterterrorism.
During the press conference, he alleged that a provincial forests minister had links to the timber mafia and claimed that certain PTI leaders had accumulated substantial business interests while holding public office.
Wali urged the people of K-P to compare the province’s development record with that of other parts of Pakistan. He said residents deserved comparable standards of healthcare, education, infrastructure and security, adding that shortcomings existed across the country but should not be used to justify a lack of progress in K-P.
PM’s Coordinator on Information for K-P Affairs Wali also accused the PTI of exploiting Pakhtun identity for political gains, alleging that the party’s rule had even damaged the province’s political culture.
“The culture of respect has disappeared and now people respond with slurs and offensive language,” Wali said, adding that the party should stop what he described as playing the “Pakhtun card” and concentrate on improving public services and living standards in the province.
Read more: ‘No way back’: Afridi vows to continue PTI long march as convoy reaches Peshawar
“No one needs their certification to identify as a Pakhtun,” he remarked.
He urged the K-P government to focus on the province’s development rather than political confrontation, calling for the reopening of Malam Jabba and the BRT system. Wali also alleged that a Rs200 billion Peshawar revitalisation project had been lost to corruption.
In strongly worded remarks, Wali alleged that PTI’s agenda was aligned with that of the Pashtun Tahafuz Movement (PTM), the Tehreek-e-Taliban Afghanistan (TTA), the banned Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan (TTP) and other banned organisations.
“These are your military wings,” Wali said, accusing PTI of maintaining links with groups he described as hostile to the state. He did not substantiate the allegation with evidence at the press conference.
Wali called for accountability within PTI and urged the public to question their elected representatives over “persistent corruption”.
He also referred to PTI as “Fitna Khyber Pakhtunkhwa” and vowed to remove terrorism and its facilitators from the province.
Referring to recent allegations by CM Sohail Afridi on abductions of provincial lawmakers, Wali stated that PTI ministers hid on their own and claimed to be abducted by unidentified individuals.
He asked the people to question the PTI leaders as to why they are able to move freely in areas affected by terrorism in Sindh and elsewhere in the country while the rest of the people have been terrorised by these groups.
“Is their DNA the same?” he asked, questioning what he portrayed as differences in the treatment of PTI leaders across regions.
Jalal Khan questions use of counterterrorism funds
K-P MPA Jalal Khan questioned the provincial government’s claims that it lacked resources to combat terrorism, asking why funds were not being used to strengthen the police and other law enforcement agencies.
“They claim they do not have funds to counter terrorism but they have Rs200 billion in funds to beautify Peshawar?” Jalal Khan asked. He also questioned the utilisation of Rs800 billion that he said the province had received from the federal government to combat terrorism.
Jalal Khan asked why the money had not been used to improve the capacity, equipment and operational readiness of the police and other security institutions.
He said he had not received police security clearance for a meeting in Kohat, while PTI leaders were able to move around the area without fear.
Jalal Khan alleged that whenever the provincial government was questioned about governance or security, its leaders redirected the discussion towards the incarcerated PTI founder, whom he referred to as “prisoner 420”.
“We will rescue the province from these people,” he concluded.
Tarar declines to give verdict on governor’s rule
During the question-and-answer session, Tarar was asked whether governor’s rule or an emergency should be imposed in K-P.
He said he could not give a definitive assessment of the matter.
However, Tarar strongly criticised the provincial government’s performance, saying the province had suffered a significant decline under successive PTI administrations.
“K-P has never fared worse than this. Every department has collapsed during the 13 years of their reign,” Tarar said.
The information minister alleged that PTI had prioritised securing the release of its founder over the welfare of the people, arguing that the provincial leadership had failed to address persistent security and development challenges.
Comparing the situation in K-P with that in Balochistan, Tarar said the latter was confronting terrorism collectively, whereas the PTI leadership in K-P remained preoccupied with its political objectives.
He also accused PTI of repeatedly violating court orders and alleged that violence had “always” accompanied the party’s protests.
Towards the end of the press conference, Wali also criticised the Pashtun Tahafuz Movement, alleging that it supported the concept of a greater Pakhtunistan and did not recognise the Pakistan-Afghanistan border, referring to it instead as the Durand Line.
Wali said he did not support the movement because of what he described as its anti-Pakistan approach.

items.title: Pakistan eye series victory
items.summary:
Buoyed by a convincing victory in the first T20I on Friday, Pakistan will look to seal the series when they take on Sri Lanka in the second match of the three-match series at the Pindi Cricket Stadium in Rawalpindi on Sunday.
The match will begin at 6pm PST.
Pakistan made a strong start to the series, beating Sri Lanka by four wickets in the opening match. Several positives emerged from their approach, with aggressive intent standing out as the biggest takeaway. However, the hosts will need to strike a balance between attacking cricket and composure to ensure a more convincing finish.
Losing several wickets in quick succession, while firmly in control of the chase, was an area of concern. With the top order having laid the foundation, Pakistan could have avoided unnecessary dismissals and finished the contest more comfortably.
The hosts will also need to improve their fielding and wicket-keeping if they are to build on their opening success.
Captain Sahibzada Farhan led from the front
items.author: Alam Zeb Safi
items.content:
Buoyed by a convincing victory in the first T20I on Friday, Pakistan will look to seal the series when they take on Sri Lanka in the second match of the three-match series at the Pindi Cricket Stadium in Rawalpindi on Sunday.
The match will begin at 6pm PST.
Pakistan made a strong start to the series, beating Sri Lanka by four wickets in the opening match. Several positives emerged from their approach, with aggressive intent standing out as the biggest takeaway. However, the hosts will need to strike a balance between attacking cricket and composure to ensure a more convincing finish.
Losing several wickets in quick succession, while firmly in control of the chase, was an area of concern. With the top order having laid the foundation, Pakistan could have avoided unnecessary dismissals and finished the contest more comfortably.
The hosts will also need to improve their fielding and wicket-keeping if they are to build on their opening success.
Captain Sahibzada Farhan led from the front with an impressive 89 on Friday, delivering the kind of performance Pakistan needed from their new skipper, who has replaced Agha Salman.
Chasing 183, Farhan and Fakhar Zaman provided the hosts with an excellent start before Maaz Sadaqat added further impetus with his powerful hitting to help Pakistan secure the win.
Earlier, debutant pacer Imran Randhawa emerged as one of the standout performers, taking 2-21 in his four overs. He complemented senior fast bowler Naseem Shah, who claimed 3-36, including the prized wicket of Sri Lankan captain Kusal Mendis in the opening over.
Pakistan are likely to field an unchanged side for the second encounter.
Farhan said the team would continue to adopt an aggressive approach in the coming matches.
“Yes we will play with the same mindset. What I had told before the game happened and will build on it,” Farhan said.
“The way me and Fakhar started and then Maaz added to it I think was positive. Maaz is in great form and I have told him that he should benefit of it as such days do not come always,” he said.
The Pakistan captain also praised Randhawa for his performance with the new ball during the powerplay.
“I know that he is very good with the new ball and he has executed his plans quite well,” Farhan said.
Meanwhile, Sri Lanka captain Kusal Mendis will be looking for a stronger response from his team as they attempt to level the series.
Mendis emphasised the need for his batsman to adopt a more positive approach during the powerplay and capitalise on the fielding restrictions.
“We have to play positive cricket and score more runs in the powerplay,” Mendis said.
“We were 20 to 30 runs short as 200 and plus would have been a good score on this wicket. We did not bowl well in the powerplay and we will have to bowl first six overs tight and then take wickets in the middle to put pressure on the oppositions,” he said.
The Sri Lankan skipper also praised Lahiru Udara, who struck an impressive 91 off 55 balls to help the visitors post a competitive total.
“He batted really well in the middle and I hope he will carry his fine form in the series,” Mendis said.
Udara proved to be one of Sri Lanka’s biggest positives in the opening match. The wicket-keeper batsman registered his maiden T20I half-century in only his fifth appearance in the format, giving his side a much-needed boost with the bat.
Friday’s victory was Pakistan’s 19th in T20Is against Sri Lanka, taking their head-to-head record to 19-13.
Sri Lanka, however, have fond memories of their previous T20I tour of Pakistan, having swept the hosts 3-0 in a three-match series in October 2019.
Pakistan rested on Saturday, while Sri Lanka were scheduled to train at the Pindi Cricket Stadium ahead of Sunday's encounter.
The visitors are in Pakistan not only for the T20I series but also for an upcoming ODI tri-series involving England, followed by a Test series.

items.title: PTA Proposes KYC Checks and 90-Day Limit for Foreign Roaming SIMs in Pakistan
items.summary:

The Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA) has proposed mandatory identity verification for foreign SIMs and travel eSIMs operating on Pakistani mobile networks. The proposed rules also introduce a 90-day threshold for international roaming connections to address financial fraud, cybercrime, and security risks.
According to the draft International Roaming (Inbound) Regulations, 2026, foreign roaming connections used for 90 days or more within any 180-day period would be classified as permanent roaming. Telecom operators could suspend or block these connections if they cannot verify that the users have a legitimate reason for temporary use.
PTA Proposes KYC Checks and 90-Day Limit for Foreign Roaming SIMs in Pakistan
The proposed framework aims to bring international roaming services and travel SIM/eSIM providers under the PTA’s regulatory oversight.
PTA Seeks Mandatory Identity Verification
The PTA has raised concern
items.author: Onsa Mustafa
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
The Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA) has proposed mandatory identity verification for foreign SIMs and travel eSIMs operating on Pakistani mobile networks. The proposed rules also introduce a 90-day threshold for international roaming connections to address financial fraud, cybercrime, and security risks.
According to the draft International Roaming (Inbound) Regulations, 2026, foreign roaming connections used for 90 days or more within any 180-day period would be classified as permanent roaming. Telecom operators could suspend or block these connections if they cannot verify that the users have a legitimate reason for temporary use.
PTA Proposes KYC Checks and 90-Day Limit for Foreign Roaming SIMs in Pakistan
The proposed framework aims to bring international roaming services and travel SIM/eSIM providers under the PTA’s regulatory oversight.
PTA Seeks Mandatory Identity Verification
The PTA has raised concerns that foreign SIM cards and eSIMs can currently access Pakistani cellular networks without completing local Know Your Customer (KYC) verification.
According to the authority, this gap could allow criminals to use unverified connections for illegal activities while avoiding the identity checks required for locally issued SIM cards.
The PTA has identified several risks associated with these connections, including spoofed calls, SMS-based phishing, extortion, e-commerce fraud and other cybercrimes. It has also expressed concerns about the alleged use of social media accounts linked to such connections for spreading fake news, hate speech and other unlawful content.
The growing use of foreign SIMs as alternatives to locally registered connections could also weaken regulatory oversight. The authority has highlighted the potential use of these connections in machine-to-machine (M2M) and Internet of Things (IoT) devices, along with possible revenue losses for Pakistani telecom operators and the national exchequer.
See Also: PTA Inspects 115 Telecom Sites in One Week to Improve Mobile Service Quality Across Pakistan
Telecom Operators to Verify Foreign Users
Under the proposed regulations, mobile network operators would have to develop and implement a system to identify and verify people using inbound international roaming services.
The required information would include passport or travel document details, nationality, SIM or eSIM identifiers, the user’s home mobile operator and, where available, the arrival date and expected duration of stay.
Operators could complete the verification process through activation procedures, welcome SMS messages containing verification links or a PTA-approved digital portal. They could also coordinate with immigration and border-control authorities.
The draft also recognises that SMS-based verification may not work for every connection. Operators would therefore need alternative arrangements for cases where the technology is not suitable, including data-only eSIMs.
These measures are intended to make foreign roaming connections more traceable and help authorities identify users involved in suspicious activities.
Travel eSIM Providers to Register With PTA
The proposed framework would also require travel SIM and eSIM aggregators operating in Pakistan to register with the PTA.
These providers, which offer mobile connectivity to international travellers, would have to disclose their underlying network operators and distribution channels. They would also need to appoint a local representative or focal person to coordinate with the authority.
Registered providers would be required to share information about SIM and eSIM issuance, activation, KYC details, and usage when required under the proposed rules.
The PTA also plans to strengthen monitoring requirements for telecom operators. Companies would have to establish systems to identify permanent roaming connections and suspicious traffic patterns.
Operators would also need to retain specified roaming records for at least 12 months and submit periodic reports to the regulator.
Faster Response to Fraud and Security Risks
The draft regulations propose a mechanism for telecom operators to request subscriber information from foreign home operators when they detect suspicious or abusive activity.
Foreign operators would generally have 72 hours to respond to such requests. In cases involving an immediate security threat or fraud risk, the proposed response period would be 24 hours.
The framework also proposes a centralised database of blocked inbound roaming connections. This would help prevent users whose connections have been suspended from accessing Pakistani networks through another operator.
Telecom companies could suspend or block roaming services when credible information establishes that a connection has been involved in illegal or abusive activities.
Restrictions Proposed for IoT and M2M SIMs
The PTA has also proposed restrictions on the use of M2M and IoT SIM cards for ordinary consumer services, including voice calls, SMS messages, and general-purpose internet access.
These connections are primarily intended for communication between machines and connected devices. The proposed rules would allow the authority to approve genuine industrial and machine-connectivity applications on a case-by-case basis.
The measure aims to prevent specialised connectivity services from becoming an alternative route for bypassing the identity-verification requirements that apply to regular mobile users.
What the Proposed Rules Mean for Users
If implemented, the new regulations could introduce additional verification requirements for foreign visitors using roaming SIMs and travel eSIMs in Pakistan. Providers and telecom operators would also face greater compliance and monitoring responsibilities.
The proposed 90-day threshold could affect long-term roaming connections, particularly those that remain active in Pakistan for extended periods without sufficient evidence of legitimate temporary use.
However, the proposed rules do not require operators to automatically block every foreign SIM or eSIM after 90 days. The proposed framework allows operators to consider whether the connection has a legitimate temporary purpose.
The PTA says the proposed regulations aim to improve security, protect consumers, and bring Pakistan’s international roaming framework closer to international telecommunications practices.
The measures remain proposals under the draft regulations. Their final implementation will depend on the regulatory process and the rules ultimately adopted by the authority.
The post PTA Proposes KYC Checks and 90-Day Limit for Foreign Roaming SIMs in Pakistan appeared first on PhoneWorld.

items.summary:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Chinese electric vehicle manufacturer BYD is in talks with its local partner, Mega Motor Company (MMC), to introduce its next-generation ultra-fast EV charging technology in Pakistan. The move could make electric vehicles more convenient for local consumers and support the wider adoption of new energy vehicles in the country.
Liu Xueliang, Vice President of BYD and General Manager of its Asia Pacific Auto Sales Division, confirmed the discussions in an interview with Business Recorder. He said the company is exploring how to bring the technology to Pakistan in cooperation with MMC.
According to Liu, the introduction of the new charging system will depend on infrastructure readiness, consultations with relevant stakeholders, and the company’s future product plans.
BYD to Bring Ultra-Fast EV Charging Technology to Pakistan
BYD’s Mega Flash Charging technology uses the company’s second-generation Blade Battery.
items.author: Onsa Mustafa
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Chinese electric vehicle manufacturer BYD is in talks with its local partner, Mega Motor Company (MMC), to introduce its next-generation ultra-fast EV charging technology in Pakistan. The move could make electric vehicles more convenient for local consumers and support the wider adoption of new energy vehicles in the country.
Liu Xueliang, Vice President of BYD and General Manager of its Asia Pacific Auto Sales Division, confirmed the discussions in an interview with Business Recorder. He said the company is exploring how to bring the technology to Pakistan in cooperation with MMC.
According to Liu, the introduction of the new charging system will depend on infrastructure readiness, consultations with relevant stakeholders, and the company’s future product plans.
BYD to Bring Ultra-Fast EV Charging Technology to Pakistan
BYD’s Mega Flash Charging technology uses the company’s second-generation Blade Battery. The system aims to significantly reduce the time required to charge an electric vehicle, making EVs more practical for everyday use.
Faster charging could help address one of the major concerns among potential electric vehicle buyers: the time needed to recharge a battery during long journeys or daily travel.
Liu said the technology could help accelerate the adoption of new energy vehicles by making charging more convenient for consumers.
The new system is designed for next-generation vehicles equipped with BYD’s latest battery platform. However, existing BYD vehicles will also be compatible with the charging infrastructure, although they may not achieve the same charging speeds as newer models.
Despite the potential benefits, BYD has not announced a launch date for the technology in Pakistan. Its introduction will depend on the development of suitable charging infrastructure and further discussions with local partners.
BYD’s Local Manufacturing Plant Nears Launch
Alongside its charging technology plans, BYD is preparing to launch its manufacturing facility in Pakistan. Liu said the project is approaching its planned launch in the second half of 2026.
The facility will be BYD’s sixth manufacturing plant outside China and will initially have an annual production capacity of 25,000 vehicles. The company could expand this capacity to 50,000 units per year, depending on future requirements.
The manufacturing project is expected to create more than 1,100 jobs and support the development of Pakistan’s automotive industry. It could also contribute to sustainable industrial growth by increasing local vehicle production.
According to Liu, the project is expected to help avoid an estimated 165,000 tonnes of carbon dioxide emissions by 2034.
BYD has not yet shared all the details of the manufacturing facility, but the company plans to provide further information as the project progresses.
See Also: Chery Master Offers PKR 1.29 Million Upfront Savings on Tiggo 8 Super Hybrid AWD
What It Means for Pakistan’s EV Market
The potential introduction of ultra-fast charging technology could be an important development for Pakistan’s electric vehicle market. Shorter charging times could make EVs more attractive to consumers who are concerned about charging convenience and long-distance travel.
However, the benefits will depend on the availability of compatible charging stations, reliable electricity supplies, and supporting infrastructure across major cities and highways.
BYD’s planned manufacturing facility could also strengthen its position in Pakistan by supporting local production and creating employment opportunities.
For now, the ultra-fast charging system remains under discussion. If BYD and MMC move forward with the plan, Pakistan could eventually gain access to faster EV charging technology as the country’s electric mobility sector continues to develop.

items.summary:

The Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA) continues to strengthen field monitoring and inspections of mobile network infrastructure across the country to improve service quality, coverage, and availability. During the week from 30th September to 7th October, 2026, PTA’s zonal offices’ teams inspected total 115 telecom sites across various regions of Pakistan.
The inspections covered 39 sites in Lahore, 17 in Karachi, 16 in Sukkur, 14 each in Multan and Rawalpindi, 8 in Quetta, 4 in Abbottabad, and 3 in Gilgit. The field teams assessed network performance, voice and data services quality, coverage, and the availability of backup power arrangements. Improvements in mobile service quality have also been observed in several of the areas covered by these inspections.

The monitoring exercise focused on identifying issues affecting
items.author: Press Release
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
The Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA) continues to strengthen field monitoring and inspections of mobile network infrastructure across the country to improve service quality, coverage, and availability. During the week from 30th September to 7th October, 2026, PTA’s zonal offices’ teams inspected total 115 telecom sites across various regions of Pakistan.
The inspections covered 39 sites in Lahore, 17 in Karachi, 16 in Sukkur, 14 each in Multan and Rawalpindi, 8 in Quetta, 4 in Abbottabad, and 3 in Gilgit. The field teams assessed network performance, voice and data services quality, coverage, and the availability of backup power arrangements. Improvements in mobile service quality have also been observed in several of the areas covered by these inspections.
PTA Inspects 115 Telecom Sites in One Week to Improve Mobile Service Quality Across Pakistan
The monitoring exercise focused on identifying issues affecting consumers, including call connection failures, dropped calls, slow mobile internet speeds, and network coverage gaps. Field teams also reviewed consumer feedback and complaints to better understand service-related challenges. Engagement with local administrations, elected representatives, and community members are being undertaken to facilitate the identification and resolution of issues affecting mobile services in different areas.
Where deficiencies or technical issues are identified at telecom sites and towers, the relevant mobile operators are directed to undertake necessary corrective measures. These interventions are aimed at addressing service-related shortcomings and ensuring sustained improvements in network performance.
See Also: Poor Call Quality? PTA Tells Mobile Users to Check 4G Settings, Handset and SIM First
PTA remains committed to strengthening regulatory oversight, monitoring mobile operators’ performance, and ensuring timely identification and resolution of consumer concerns. These ongoing efforts aim to improve the quality, reliability, and availability of mobile telecommunications services and enhance the overall experience of consumers across Pakistan.

items.content:
Saturday night saw a flurry of meetings in Islamabad to deliberate on the country's overall political and security situation amid intense friction between the Centre and the Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa government on the issue of terrorism in the province and the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf's long march to Islamabad that has led to threats of imposing federal rule.
In a post on X, the Presidency said Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and President Asif Ali Zardari met at the Aiwan-e-Sadr where they "exchanged views on the country's overall political and security situation".
The meeting comprised senior government and PPP leaders, including Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar, Prime Minister's Adviser on Political Affairs Rana Sanaullah, Federal Minister for Interior Mohsin Naqvi, Attorney General Mansoor Usman Awan, Minister for Law and Justice Azam Nazeer Tarar, Senator Sherry Rehman and more.
"It was agreed in the meeting to convene separate sessions of the National Assembly and Senate on Tuesday," the statement said.
صدرِ مملکت آصف علی زرداری سے وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف کی ایوانِ صدر میں ملاقات، ملک کی مجموعی سیاسی اور سیکیورٹی صورتِ حال پر تبادلہ خیال۔
ملاقات میں وزیر اعظم کی معاونت نائب وزیراعظم سینیٹر اسحاق ڈار، وزیراعظم کے مشیر برائے سیاسی امور سینیٹر رانا ثناء الّلہ، وفاقی وزیر داخلہ… pic.twitter.com/r1T1bTXTy4
— The President of Pakistan (@PresOfPakistan) October 10, 2026
Questioned about the meeting, Minister of State for Interior Talal Chaudhry said on a private television channel’s talk show that a detailed discussion had taken place on the possibility of imposing an emergency, but negotiations were still under way and all options were being considered.
He said the government had exhausted several avenues, including parliamentary engagement and backchannel contacts, before considering the measure, describing an emergency as a last resort for a political government.
“It's definitely not a praiseworthy move and for a political government such a measure is always a last resort,” he said, adding that different levels and options of an emergency as well as other constitutional options had been discussed.
Chaudhry said the government was still assessing the situation, although he saw developments moving towards what he called the “last option”.
He argued that the federal government had offered to accommodate the opposition’s political demands if it agreed to support the centre’s efforts against terrorism under the National Action Plan (NAP), which he said had been developed by the PTI founder.
Recalling the second day of government-opposition negotiations before the proposed long march, he said PM Shehbaz had told the interior minister that the opposition could have its political demands met if it supported the centre in the fight against terrorism.
Chaudhry questioned what options would remain if the government met the opposition’s political demands but the latter did not unequivocally condemn militant groups or support counterterrorism efforts. He also alleged that the proposed long march was targeting national policy in a manner that could incite rebellion against the state.
The minister said the federal government had not drafted a new counterterrorism document and was instead implementing the framework prepared under the PTI government.
Responding to the PTI’s position that all stakeholders should be included in dialogue on counterterrorism, the minister questioned the provincial government’s commitment to tackling militancy. He cited the absence of counterterrorism departments, forensic laboratories and safe-city surveillance cameras, and alleged that provincial leaders had avoided attending the funerals of security personnel killed in terrorist attacks.
He maintained that talks with the K-P government had never completely stopped, including through other political parties.
Meanwhile, Federal Minister for Kashmir Affairs and Gilgit-Baltistan Engineer Amir Muqam called for the imposition of governor’s rule across K-P, citing what he described as the provincial government’s failure to maintain law and order and establish its writ.
“There is no writ of the government in K-P, nor does it have any [governance] priorities,” he said, alleging that terrorists were operating freely because of inadequate security arrangements and a lack of checkpoints.
“We collect dead bodies every day,” he said, accusing the provincial government of failing to adequately condemn attacks on the armed forces or take decisive action against militants.
Referring to the security situation in Lakki Marwat and Bannu, he said residents were increasingly reluctant to move around, while militant activity and insecurity continued to affect daily life. However, the PTI rally, suggesting support from terror outfits, moved around freely in these no-go areas at night.
“We, too, are citizens of Pakistan who deserve to live in peace,” he said. Muqam argued that if the provincial government was unable to protect citizens and enforce its authority, the federal government should intervene.
He thereby reiterated that governor’s rule should be implemented throughout the province for the sake of people’s well-being and safety.
Speaking on talks between the opposition and the government, the minister said the negotiations with PTI and other members of the opposition had included a proposal for a joint declaration by the K-P chief minister and the interior minister explicitly condemning terrorism, but claimed that Chief Minister Sohail Afridi had backed away from the proposal.
He also alleged that the negotiations had failed because of the chief minister’s reluctance to call out terrorism for what it truly is, while maintaining that the delegation of opposition had been sincere in seeking a resolution of conflict and the dialogue was foiled by the chief minister.
When probed whether the federal government had support of the people of K-P regarding the mulled constitutional measures including emergency imposition, Muqam claimed that 5,000 to 6,000 people had attended a rally he organised in support of peace in the province, despite short notice and an internet shutdown. He interpreted the participation as evidence of public opposition to the provincial government.
The federal government’s deliberations come amid continuing political differences over the province’s security situation, the implementation of the National Action Plan and the role of the provincial administration in countering terrorism. With negotiations reportedly still in progress, an emergency or governor’s rule remains a matter under discussion rather than a confirmed decision.
Later, the president held a meeting with K-P Governor Faisal Karim Kundi and Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi, in which they briefed him on the overall security situation in the country, particularly the deteriorating law and order situation in K-P.
The president was informed about security matters in the province and issues related to law and order in the country.
گورنر خیبر پختونخوا فیصل کریم کنڈی اور وفاقی وزیر داخلہ سینیٹر محسن نقوی کی صدرِ مملکت آصف علی زرداری سے ملاقات۔
صدرِ مملکت کو ملک کی مجموعی سیکیورٹی صورتحال، بالخصوص خیبر پختونخوا میں بگڑتی ہوئی امن و امان کی صورتحال پر بریفنگ۔
ملاقات میں خیبر پختونخوا کی سیکیورٹی اور ملک میں… pic.twitter.com/6gftMtjZkr
— The President of Pakistan (@PresOfPakistan) October 10, 2026
In a post on X, Kundi said: "KP has sacrificed enough. Protecting lives and defeating terrorism must take precedence over political interests."
Called on @PresOfPakistan Asif Ali Zardari alongside Federal Interior Minister Senator @MohsinnaqviC42 to brief him on the deteriorating security situation in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and the country’s overall law and order. KP has sacrificed enough. Protecting lives and defeating… pic.twitter.com/P2sikowz8t
— Faisal Karim Kundi (@fkkundi) October 10, 2026
Speaking to the media elsewhere, Naqvi asked: "Is there really any room left to avoid imposing an emergency? You tell me, how can this matter be averted? Ask them just how much effort I have made to find a solution. They will tell you themselves the extent of the efforts Mohsin Naqvi has made to resolve the issue."
The interior minister reiterated that there was "no room left now".
Fazl's role in mediation
Amid the friction between the Centre and K-P, Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam-Fazl (JUI-F) chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman has once again jumped into the fray as a possible mediator.
He held a meeting with the premier at the PM House, in which consultations were held on "important national and political matters".
وزیرِ اعظم محمد شہباز شریف اور سربراہ جمیعت علماء اسلام مولانا فضل الرحمن کے درمیان وزیر اعظم ہاؤس میں ملاقات، اہم قومی و سیاسی امور پر مشاورت ہوئی. pic.twitter.com/6rI4uWUadF
— Prime Minister's Office (@PakPMO) October 10, 2026
The JUI said the meeting took place at PM Shehbaz's invitation and the PTI leadership was taken into confidence as well before leaving for the talks.
وزیر اعظم مولانا فضل الرحمان ملاقات
مولانا فضل الرحمان اپنی رہائش گاہ سے وزیراعظم ہاؤس روانہ ہو گئے۔ ترجمان جےیوآئی
ملاقات وزیر اعظم کی دعوت پر ہو رہی ہے۔ ترجمان جےیوآئی
وفد میں سنیٹر مولانا عطاء الحق درویش۔ مولانا لطف الرحمان ۔ اور سنیٹر کامران مرتضی شامل ہیں۔اسلم غوری…
— Jamiat Ulama-e-Islam Pakistan (@juipakofficial) October 10, 2026
The meeting came after PM Shehbaz and Fazl earlier discussed ways to ease tensions between the federal and K-P governments during a telephone conversation, the Prime Minister’s Office (PMO) said.
“Fazl also spoke to the prime minister about reducing tensions between the federal government and the K-P government,” the statement added.
وزیراعظم شہباز شریف کا مولانا فضل الرحمان سے ٹیلی فونک رابطہ۔@CMShehbaz pic.twitter.com/BJ90XusJtz
— PTV News (@PTVNewsOfficial) October 10, 2026
JUI-F spokesperson Aslam Ghauri, in a statement released by the party's media cell, said the two leaders had discussed the current political situation and the ongoing tensions between the federal and K-P governments.
Ghauri added that Fazl remained in regular contact with the PTI leadership and had taken it into confidence as part of efforts to ease political tensions in the country.
ترجمان:جےیوآئی
10 اکتوبر
اسلام آباد: وزیراعظم میاں شہباز شریف کا امیر جے یو آئی مولانا فضل الرحمان سے ٹیلی فونک رابطہ
وزیراعظم میاں شہباز شریف کی امیر جے یو آئی مولانا فضل الرحمان سے موجودہ سیاسی صورتحال پر گفتگو ہوئی ۔
خیبرپختونخوا حکومت اور وفاق کے درمیان جاری تناؤ ختم کرنے…
— Aslam Ghauri (@AslamGhauriJUI) October 10, 2026
Speaking to The Express Tribune, PTI Secretary Information Sheikh Waqas Akram said that the party would welcome a positive and effective role by Fazl in reducing the ongoing political tensions and uncertainty in the country.
Akram stated that his intervention would be “welcomed”, adding that PTI would appreciate his efforts in this regard.
He emphasised that Pakistan needed political wisdom, patience, serious and meaningful initiatives, and dialogue rather than confrontation to address the current political challenges.
Muqam, Kundi slam PTI
Earlier, Muqam and Governor Kundi held a meeting at the Governor House in Peshawar, state-run Radio Pakistan reported.
During the meeting, they discussed the overall law and order situation in K-P, the ongoing long march, and other significant political matters. Expressing their gratitude to the people of K-P, both leaders said that the public has rejected the "politics of chaos".
A joint statement issued after the meeting affirmed that the federal government would take all possible measures to ensure peace and promote public welfare and development in the province.
Minister for Kashmir Affairs and Gilgit-Baltistan Amir Muqam and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Governor @fkkundi held a meeting at the Governor House in Peshawar today. During the meeting, they discussed the overall law and order situation in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa#News #RadioPakistan…
— Radio Pakistan (@RadioPakistan) October 10, 2026
Political deadlock
The contact came as the PTI’s long march is scheduled to travel from Charsadda to Mardan on Saturday, amid efforts to revive dialogue between the government and opposition.
Fazl has emerged as a possible intermediary as efforts to revive negotiations continue. PTI K-P President Junaid Akbar said the party had authorised the JUI-F chief to mediate between the government and opposition, while PTI Chairman Barrister Gohar Ali Khan called for unconditional dialogue and urged both sides to find a way forward.
The latest efforts followed two rounds of negotiations between the government and opposition that ended without an agreement. The sides remained divided over PTI’s demand for access to its jailed founder, Imran Khan, and the role of the K-P government in determining counterterrorism policy. PTI said a joint strategy involving the federal and provincial governments was needed, while the government maintained that cooperation from the provincial administration was essential.
Efforts to resume dialogue have continued as the long march advances, with PTI leaders pressing for renewed negotiations while government figures have urged the party to reconsider its protest.
The march began on October 4 after the initial attempts to reach an agreement failed, and its route is subsequently scheduled to take the convoy through Charsadda and Mardan before reaching Swabi. PTI has said it would announce its next course of action after reaching Swabi.
The political standoff has also fuelled speculation about possible emergency measures and changes to K-P’s administrative structure. Reports citing sources have suggested that a proposal to establish a separate administrative arrangement for 12 districts is under consideration.
Sources have said that the federal government is weighing options including governor’s rule and an emergency as tensions with the provincial government deepen.

Microsoft baru saja mengubah kebijakan penyimpanan cloud OneDrive untuk pelanggan Microsoft 365 Family dan Premium. Jika sebelumnya setiap anggota mendapatkan kuota 1TB secara terpisah, kini kedua paket itu menggabungkan penyimpanan bersama menjadi 2TB dengan maksimal enam pengguna.
Perubahan ini berlaku untuk pelanggan baru pada Oktober 2026, dan berpotensi mengurangi total kapasitas penyimpanan tersedia bagi keluarga.

Microsoft baru saja mengubah kebijakan penyimpanan cloud OneDrive untuk pelanggan Microsoft 365 Family dan Premium. Jika sebelumnya setiap anggota mendapatkan kuota 1TB secara terpisah, kini kedua paket itu menggabungkan penyimpanan bersama menjadi 2TB dengan maksimal enam pengguna.
Perubahan ini berlaku untuk pelanggan baru pada Oktober 2026, dan berpotensi mengurangi total kapasitas penyimpanan tersedia bagi keluarga.
Baca Juga: Windows Search Dirombak Microsoft, Bisa Apa Selain Cari File di PC?
Sebelumnya, pelanggan Microsoft 365 Family dapat menikmati kapasitas gabungan hingga 6TB bila seluruh enam anggota menggunakan jatah masing-masing.
Lewat kebijakan baru ini, kini semua anggota harus berbagi satu penyimpanan atau shared storage sebesar 2TB. 
Pendekatan itu lebih fleksibel karena ruang kosong milik satu anggota bisa digunakan pengguna lain dalam langganan saman, ucap Microsoft, sebagaimana dikutip The Verge, Sabtu (10/10/2026).
Namun, perubahan ini juga menimbulkan konsekuensi bagi keluarga yang selama ini memanfaatkan OneDrive untuk menyimpan banyak dokumen, foto, video, dan file cadangan.
Berbagi Kuota OneDrive Microsoft 365 Family
Sebelumnya, Microsoft 365 Family menawarkan penyimpanan OneDrive 1TB untuk setiap pengguna. Dengan maksimal enam anggota dalam satu langganan, total kuota yang dapat dimanfaatkan mencapai 6TB.
Namun, kapasitas tersebut tidak digabungkan. Setiap anggota hanya dapat menggunakan jatah 1TB miliknya, meskipun anggota lain masih memiliki banyak ruang kosong.
Melalui aturan baru Microsoft 365 Family ini, raksasa teknologi tersebut menghilangkan batas penyimpanan individual dan menggantinya dengan kumpulan penyimpanan 2TB digunakan bersama.
Artinya, salah satu anggota keluarga bisa menggunakan lebih dari 1TB apabila anggota lain tidak banyak menggunakan ruang penyimpanan. Sebaliknya, keluarga yang sebelumnya menghabiskan lebih dari 2TB secara keseluruhan harus menyesuaikan penggunaan mereka.
Selain Microsoft 365 Family, perubahan serupa juga berlaku untuk Microsoft 365 Premium. Sementara itu, Microsoft 365 Personal tetap menawarkan penyimpanan 1TB untuk satu pengguna, sedangkan paket Pro menggunakan kuota bersama 5TB.
Microsoft menjelaskan perubahan ini dimaksudkan untuk mengurangi kondisi ketika seorang pengguna kehabisan ruang, sementara anggota keluarga lainnya memiliki kapasitas yang jarang digunakan.
Meski demikian, fleksibilitas tersebut datang dengan pengurangan total kapasitas yang cukup besar bagi keluarga dengan banyak pengguna aktif.
Kapan Aturan OneDrive 2TB Mulai Berlaku?
Microsoft mulai menerapkan kuota bersama untuk langganan Microsoft 365 Family dan Premium baru pada Oktober 2026. Ketentuan ini juga mencakup pembelian ulang langganan yang telah kedaluwarsa.
Namun, pelanggan lama tidak langsung kehilangan kuota 1TB per orang begitu aturan tersebut diumumkan.
Microsoft menerapkan transisi berdasarkan periode perpanjangan langganan pada 2027. Sejumlah halaman dukungan Microsoft mencantumkan jadwal berbeda, yakni perpanjangan mulai April 2027 dan Mei 2027, sehingga pelanggan sebaiknya memeriksa pemberitahuan yang dikirimkan ke akun masing-masing.
Pelanggan yang mengganti paket lebih awal juga berpotensi berpindah ke model kuota bersama sebelum jadwal perpanjangan semula.
Perusahaan menyebut, pelanggan lama yang memenuhi syarat di wilayah tertentu dapat memperoleh tambahan kapasitas penyimpanan selama masa transisi. Namun, ketersediaan dan besaran kuota tambahan tersebut bergantung pada ketentuan yang berlaku bagi setiap akun.
Karena itu, pengguna sebaiknya tidak langsung menganggap kuota OneDrive mereka telah berubah sebelum memeriksa informasi langganan.
Bagaimana Jika File Keluarga Sudah Melebihi 2TB?
Ilustrasi Microsoft Office 365 (pinterest)
Lalu apa yang terjadi apabila sebuah keluarga sudah menggunakan penyimpanan lebih dari 2TB sebelum kebijakan baru diterapkan. Microsoft menyatakan file pengguna tidak langsung dihapus ketika penggunaan melampaui batas penyimpanan baru.
Perusahaan memberikan masa penyesuaian sehingga pelanggan dapat mengelola file, mengosongkan ruang, atau menambah kapasitas penyimpanan.
Menurut penjelasan pada halaman dukungan Microsoft, pengguna yang melewati kuota masih dapat mengakses file hingga satu tahun selama proses penyesuaian. Namun, kelebihan penggunaan dapat membatasi kemampuan menyimpan atau menyinkronkan data baru.
Raksasa teknologi itu juga menawarkan opsi pembelian kapasitas OneDrive tambahan, dengan batas perluasan hingga 10TB untuk paket yang mendukung.
Bagi keluarga yang selama ini menggunakan layanan OneDrive untuk mencadangkan foto dan video dari beberapa perangkat, perubahan ini patut diperhatikan sebelum memperpanjang langganan di bulan berikutnya.
Pelanggan dapat memeriksa penggunaan penyimpanan melalui dasbor akun Microsoft untuk mengetahui seberapa besar kuota yang sudah digunakan dan berapa banyak kapasitas tersisa.

items.title: PM appreciates collective efforts as fuel subsidy beneficiaries cross 10m; announces National Award for IT Minister
items.summary:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif on Friday appreciated the collective efforts of the federal and provincial governments and relevant institutions as the number of direct beneficiaries of the government’s fuel subsidy scheme crossed 10 million, announcing a national award for the Information and Technology Minister Shaza Fatima Khawaja.
Hosting a high tea to recognize ministers and government officials for their efforts in executing the landmark scheme and ensuring its transparent outreach, the prime minister said the government would also honor others with shields to acknowledge their dedication and sustained hard work.
He said the scheme had faced several challenges and concerns at the planning stage, but coordinated efforts by all stakeholders had helped it achieve significant progress.
The prime minister resolved that the programme would continue as the government had allocated Rs75 billion for the initiative.

items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif on Friday appreciated the collective efforts of the federal and provincial governments and relevant institutions as the number of direct beneficiaries of the government’s fuel subsidy scheme crossed 10 million, announcing a national award for the Information and Technology Minister Shaza Fatima Khawaja.
Hosting a high tea to recognize ministers and government officials for their efforts in executing the landmark scheme and ensuring its transparent outreach, the prime minister said the government would also honor others with shields to acknowledge their dedication and sustained hard work.
He said the scheme had faced several challenges and concerns at the planning stage, but coordinated efforts by all stakeholders had helped it achieve significant progress.
The prime minister resolved that the programme would continue as the government had allocated Rs75 billion for the initiative.
The prime minister expressed gratitude to the provincial governments and their chief ministers for extending support to the initiative, and said its success would not have been possible without their cooperation.
He said the number of people directly benefiting from the scheme had crossed 10 million, including motorcyclists, rickshaw and Qingqi operators, and owners of cars up to 800cc.
The initiative was providing eligible beneficiaries with fuel subsidy and that the benefits also extended indirectly to their families.
The prime minister estimated that, considering an average household size of five, around 50 million people were benefiting directly or indirectly from the scheme.
He recalled that an earlier initiative launched in February had recorded the redemption of around 1.3 million fuel subsidy tokens at its peak. He said the concerted efforts of the federal and provincial governments had enabled the current scheme to expand its reach considerably.
The prime minister particularly acknowledged the contributions of Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar, Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb, IT Minister Shaza Fatima Khawaja, Planning Minister Ahsan Iqbal, relevant federal secretaries and officials, as well as provincial chief secretaries and other institutions involved in the implementation process.
Describing the achievement as an example of effective teamwork, he praised the officials for their unwavering commitment, dedication and tireless efforts.
He also appreciated the contributions of the Petroleum Division, Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (OGRA), State Bank of Pakistan, National Database and Registration Authority (NADRA), Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA), telecommunications operators and other relevant organisations.
The prime minister announced that Shaza Fatima Khawaja would receive a national award in March in recognition of her role, adding that other contributors would also be presented with shields.
Sharing the statistics of the scheme, Prime Minister Shehbaz said that more than 10.8 million citizens had registered for the scheme, while approximately 27 million tokens had been issued. Of these, around 19.4 million tokens had been redeemed by citizens to obtain fuel at subsidised rates. Out of this figure approximately 9.2 million citizens had used tokens more than once, while nearly 96 per cent benefeciaries were of motorcyclists.

items.title: 11 killed, including three children, in overnight Russia-Ukraine strikes
items.summary:
Overnight Russian and Ukrainian strikes killed at least 11 people, including three children, and injured 22 others, officials from both countries said on Saturday.
In Ukraine, a Russian attack on the southeastern city of Zaporizhzhia killed 11 people, including three children, regional military administration head Mykhailo Semikin said on Telegram.
He said search-and-rescue operations were ongoing and people could still be trapped under the rubble following the attack.
Ivan Fedorov, co-chair of the Zaporizhzhia Regional Defence Council, said 16 people were injured in the Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia, adding: “The fate of another 12 people remains unknown.”
Separately, Ukraine’s Air Force on Telegram accused Russia of launching 160 drones, with 117 of them shot down or suppressed.
In Russia, a Ukrainian drone attack on the southern Rostov region injured six people, regional Gov. Yury Slyusar said.
Read: Russia hits Ukraine with drones and missiles, killing at least 1

items.content:

In Ukraine, a Russian attack on the southeastern city of Zaporizhzhia killed 11 people, including three children, regional military administration head Mykhailo Semikin said on Telegram.
He said search-and-rescue operations were ongoing and people could still be trapped under the rubble following the attack.
Ivan Fedorov, co-chair of the Zaporizhzhia Regional Defence Council, said 16 people were injured in the Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia, adding: “The fate of another 12 people remains unknown.”
Separately, Ukraine’s Air Force on Telegram accused Russia of launching 160 drones, with 117 of them shot down or suppressed.

He said several apartment buildings and private houses in Rostov-on-Don were damaged, along with an unoccupied new building in Bataysk and two vessels in Azov. No casualties were initially reported aboard the ships.
Moscow Mayor Sergey Sobyanin said on Telegram that 403 drones headed toward the Moscow region overnight, with a “majority” of them neutralised by air defence forces at long range, adding that 25 drones were destroyed as they approached the Russian capital.
Russia’s Defence Ministry, meanwhile, said its air defences intercepted or destroyed 560 Ukrainian drones over Russian regions, Crimea -- which Moscow annexed in 2014 -- and the Black Sea and the Sea of Azov overnight.
The ministry also said Russian forces struck Ukrainian port infrastructure and vessels allegedly used in the interests of Ukraine’s military, including a cargo ship carrying military-related supplies to the port of Odesa.
Independent verification of the claims from both sides remains difficult due to the ongoing war.

items.author: Yus Lianson
items.content:
AnyPS5, software yang dikembangkan untuk memainkan game PlayStation 5 (PS5) di OS Windows dan Linux tanpa harus pakai emulator konvensional mencatat kemajuan baru.
TechPowerUp melaporkan, proyek ini telah mencakup 1.166 instruksi grafis dalam daftar pelacakan, salah satu bagian penting agar game PS5 bisa berjalan di platform PC.
Bagi pemain, capaian tersebut membuka peluang untuk memainkan lebih banyak game PS5 di komputer. Namun, AnyPS5 belum bisa dianggap sebagai aplikasi tinggal di install di PC untuk menjalankan semua game konsol Sony.
Baca Juga: Hasil MPL ID S18: EVOS Taklukkan ONIC, RRQ Makin Sulit Lolos Playoff
Apa Itu AnyPS5?
AnyPS5 merupakan proyek open source menyesuaikan berkas program PS5 agar dapat berjalan di Windows atau Linux. Software ini juga menyediakan fungsi pengganti untuk layanan sistem konsol yang dibutuhkan game.
Bayangkan game meminta suatu fungsi kepada sistem PS5. AnyPS5 berusaha menyediakan fungsi yang sesuai di PC agar program dapat melanjutkan proses. Dukungan harus mencakup kebutuhan game, bukan hanya membuat berkas program bisa dibuka.
Pendekatan ini dimungkinkan karena PS5 memakai arsitektur CPU x86-64, yang juga digunakan banyak prosesor PC. AnyPS5 berfokus pada konversi program dan penyesuaian fungsi sistem tanpa harus meniru CPU konsol melalui emulasi.
Game Apa yang Sudah Berjalan?
Contoh konkret yang dicantumkan pengembang adalah Dreaming Sarah. Game platformer 2D tersebut dilaporkan berjalan stabil pada 60 fps menggunakan kartu grafis GeForce GTX 1050 Ti dan prosesor Intel Core i5-7500 3,4 GHz.
Catatan ini menunjukkan AnyPS5 sudah memiliki hasil yang melampaui sekadar membuka program. Namun, konfigurasi tersebut merupakan perangkat pengujian untuk Dreaming Sarah, bukan spesifikasi minimum seluruh game PS5.
Apa arti kemajuan grafis AnyPS5?
Capaian terbaru berkaitan dengan shader, program kecil yang membantu kartu grafis mengolah warna, pencahayaan, dan efek visual. Agar tampilan game PS5 dapat diproses di PC, kode shader perlu disesuaikan.
AnyPS5 mengolah ulang kode tersebut menjadi SPIR-V, format yang dapat digunakan melalui Vulkan, teknologi grafis yang tersedia di PC. Ini menjadi salah satu penghubung antara kode grafis konsol dan kartu grafis komputer.
TechPowerUp menyebut cakupan instruksi shader telah mencapai 100%. Akan tetapi, dokumentasi AnyPS5 menjelaskan bahwa instruksi dihitung sebagai terimplementasi ketika decoder, bagian yang membaca instruksi, sudah mengenali instruksi tersebut.
Alasan Semua Game PS5 Belum Bisa Dimainkan
Game juga bergantung pada fungsi sistem untuk kebutuhan seperti penyimpanan data dan audio. Bagian ini masih dikembangkan.
Laporan TechPowerUp mencatat, sekitar 84,81 persen fungsi pustaka sistem dalam daftar proyek telah terimplementasi. Angka tersebut mengukur fungsi yang sudah dicatat pengembang, bukan seluruh fungsi PS5 atau persentase game yang kompatibel.
Daftar itu dapat bertambah saat kebutuhan lain ditemukan. Dokumentasi teknis juga masih mencatat keterbatasan, termasuk audio 3D yang belum menghasilkan suara serta perilaku tertentu yang belum diverifikasi pada konsol.
Karena itu, mencapai 100% pada daftar fungsi belum otomatis menjamin seluruh game berjalan lancar. Dukungan yang lengkap perlu disertai perilaku sistem yang tepat dan hasil pengujian game.
Bagaimana dengan Demo Menu PS5 di PC?
Demo antarmuka PS5 yang beredar merupakan perkembangan berbeda dari AnyPS5. Dokumentasi emulator RPCSX menyatakan proyek tersebut sudah dapat membuka antarmuka menu PS4 dan PS5, yang disebut VSH.
Namun, kemampuan meluncurkan game langsung dari menu tersebut masih dikembangkan. Keberhasilan menampilkan menu PS5 di PC belum membuktikan seluruh sistem konsol atau katalog game sudah berjalan.
Untuk menilai manfaat AnyPS5, pemain perlu melihat dukungan per judul: apakah game dapat dimainkan, apakah gambar dan audio berfungsi, serta seberapa stabil performa selama bermain. Catatan pengujian seperti ini akan lebih berguna daripada angka progres teknis semata.
Forza Horizon 6 Akhirnya Punya Jadwal Rilis di PS5
Di sisi lain, Playground Games akhirnya mengumumkan tanggal rilis Forza Horizon 6 di platform konsol PlayStation 5 (PS5), setelah bulan lalu pengembang menjanjikan game tersebut meluncur pada 2026.
Studio game ini akan merilis game balap Forza Horizon 6 PS5 pada 26 Januari 2027. Kepastian tersebut disampaikan langsung lewat situs resmi Forza pada Kamis, 8 Oktober 2026, kemarin.
Bersamaan dengan pengumuman jadwal rilis, Playground Games juga sudah secara resmi membuka preorder Forza Horizon 6 lewat PlayStation Store.
Jadwal Rilis Forza Horizon 6 PS5 dan Bonus Preorder
Forza Horizon 6 siap rilis di PS5, kapan? (Doc: Playground Games)
Playground Games menyediakan tiga edisi Forza Horizon 6 di PS5, yakni Standard, Deluxe, dan Premium.
Versi Standard dan Deluxe akan tersedia pada 26 Januari 2027. Sementara itu, pemilik Premium Edition bisa mendapatkan akses lebih awal mulai 21 Januari 2027, atau lima hari sebelum jadwal rilis reguler.
Premium Edition juga menawarkan sejumlah konten tambahan, seperti VIP Membership, Welcome Pack, Car Pass, Time Attack Car Pack, Italian Passion Car Pack, serta dua ekspansi.
Ekspansi pertama dijadwalkan hadir pada 21 Januari 2027, bertepatan dengan dimulainya early access versi PS5. Konten tersebut juga akan tersedia untuk pemain Xbox dan PC.
Selain versi digital, Playground Games memastikan Forza Horizon 6 akan hadir dalam edisi fisik PS5 melalui retailer yang mendukung.
Untuk bonus preorder, pemain yang pesan salah satu edisi Forza Horizon 6 akan mendapatkan Ferrari J50 dengan pengaturan tuning khusus. Mobil tersebut bisa digunakan setelah pemain menyelesaikan bagian prolog.
Untuk pemilik PS5 di Indonesia, harga preorder Forza Horizon 6 versi standar dibanderol Rp 998.000. Sedangkan untuk Deluxe Edition dijual seharga Rp 1.442.000 dan Rp 1.775.000 untuk Premium Edition.

Key Startup Funding Highlights Of The Week
Ecommerce dominated the funding charts this week, attracting $63.9 Mn across nine deals. DailyObjects’ $34.3 Mn Series C emerged as the biggest contributor, accounting for over half of the total capital deployed in the segment.
Fintech ranked second with $24 Mn in funding, followed by advanced hardware and technology at $10 Mn. Edtech and healthtech secured $9 Mn and $8 Mn, respectively.
Early-stage funding gained traction, with pre-seed and seed-stage startups collectively raising $12.5 Mn across nine deals.
3one4 Capital, Fireside Ventures, Prime Venture Partners and AJVC led investor activity, backing two startups apiece.
Startup M&A Updates Of The Week
Hoola Health acquired early-childhood development platform UpTodd to strengthen its paediatric care offerings.
Marico acquired an additional 24.09% stake in plant-based nutrition and personal care brand Plix for ₹1,012.03 Cr in an all-cash deal, taking its total holding to 84.09%.
Walmart-owned Flipkart acquired a minority stake in Delhi-based B2B travel tech startup TravClan to strengthen its international travel offerings and expand holiday packages through Cleartrip and Flipkart Travel.
Startup IPO Updates Of The Week
Swara Baby Products, a contract manufacturer of disposable hygiene products and a subsidiary of FirstCry parent Brainbees Solutions, received SEBI’s approval for its proposed ₹1,000 Cr IPO.
Snapdeal parent AceVector made a weak stock market debut at the start of the week, listing at 11.6% discount at ₹28.30 to its issue price of ₹32 per share
Dronetech startup AITMC Ventures filed its updated draft red herring prospectus (UDRHP) with SEBI for an IPO comprising a fresh issue of up to 3.5 Cr shares, with no offer for sale (OFS) component months after receiving regulatory go-ahead
Other Developments Of The Week
IPO-bound study abroad platform Leverage Edu is looking to raise ₹500 Cr in a pre-IPO funding round to bring a large private equity firm onto its cap table, sources told Inc42.
Frontier AI research startup FYDY (Fuzzy Dynamics), which is operating in stealth mode, is in advanced talks to raise $12 Mn (about ₹115 Cr) in its maiden funding round. Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst are co-leading the round, sources told Inc42.
Nabventures, the venture capital arm of the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD), announced the first close of its second fund at ₹450 Cr, with a target corpus of ₹1,500 Cr, including a greenshoe option.
